rites.name: Alaaneth
rites.text: Alaaneth is a concept of a bound elemental choir, a chorus of four attuned spirits that answer to a single caller and fold their elements into one another. Their gathered power can scour a settlement's airspace, hold a river's course, or tear a hillside into dust in a single unified breath.

rites.name: Silamwen
rites.text: Silamwen is a concept of storm-bound retribution in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a wronged creature's assailant is briefly wrapped in a pocket of primordial weather. Its wielders spend an age's worth of practice learning to answer harm with a single crackling pointed gesture.

rites.name: Venerlionys
rites.text: Venerlionys is a primordial tempest of the Arcane realm, an ancient storm-wardian born in the third age of Miana to keep the ground's old fire from waking. It can call four sky-rents over any four points it can see, each one spilling a thunderous sphere that wraps around corners and gnaws at flesh and stone alike.

rites.name: Lyemirwen
rites.text: Lyemirwen is a three-phase storm of chaotic arcane force that roars outward in a sixty-foot fan, cycling through frost, thunder, and wildfire with each pulse and leaving the ground treacherous. Its wave-cycle is a lattice of elemental resonance that steadily gathers strength across the Arcane realm of Miana's third age. It is a tool of controlled chaos, shaped by practitioners who learned to command turbulence.

rites.name: Veniolora
rites.text: Veniolora is a concept of Arcane nature in the Miana universe, a discipline of aerial grace that lets its practitioners tumble and hang in the air for as long as their momentum holds. Its mastery is taught in the third age of the era and rewards agility over heavy armor. Adepts who falter in midair must find a way to catch themselves, or they plummet.

rites.name: Ryannaereth
rites.text: Ryannaereth is a concept of gale-borne flight in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a roaring surge of wind hurls a caster skyward toward the nearest living thing. Its blows carry thunderous and crushing force, and it lets the caster brace against falls that would otherwise drop them to earth.

rites.name: Venamaeriel
rites.text: Venamaeriel is a squall-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, born in the third age as a restless cloud that answers to whoever stands upon its back. Its wisdom is mostly in the weather it can call, and it will rain down its charge only on those it has chosen to strike.

rites.name: Silenora
rites.text: Silenora is a sorcerous bubble of seething water summoned to trap a single foe in a rising, scalding sphere that drags its captive higher with every turn. Inside the boiling globe, victims are blinded by steam and slowly cooked until they break free or fall from the sky.

rites.name: Elenaelys
rites.text: Elenaelys is a Arcane concept of the E4 era in Miana, a flame-driven ascent technique that hurls a practitioner skyward along a fixed line before a barrier-wrapped strike. Its practitioners treat the blast as a controlled burst, so the energy stays modest compared with the wider world's great powers.

rites.name: Nualireth
rites.text: Nualireth is a concept-level arcane force in the Miana omniverse, a binding of rising winds that lifts a chosen being off its footing and holds it suspended above the ground. Its power is measured in the local scale of hurricanes and falling stone rather than planetary ruin, and it is widely taught as the first lesson in controlled air-shaping.

rites.name: Ryilora
rites.text: Ryilora is a veil of woven arcane force that its wielder conjures from the air during a fall, stretching it between two hands like a taut sail. The sheet bleeds the plunge into a slow, gliding drift, letting a caster cross wide distances above the ground. Its drift is carried wherever the winds of Miana choose to push it.

rites.name: Ryerlaemiel
rites.text: Ryerlaemiel is a concept in Miana's arcane realm, a form of self-transformation in which the bearer's flesh dissolves into drifting storm-clouds that hum with a chosen current of lightning or thunder. In this state the bearer drifts above the ground, cannot be bound or caught, and shrugs off plague and toxin while the cloud-form holds. Its magic lets the bearer's own spells cut through defenses, though the form ends in a sudden drop if the bearer cannot hold themselves aloft.

rites.name: Sileima
rites.text: Sileima is an arcane concept of the Miana omniverse, a binding that lifts a willing bearer into the air at swift pace while sharpening their guard and reflexes. When the binding unravels, any bearer still aloft drops unless they can catch themselves. Its strength scales with the number of bearers the caster chooses to lift at once.

rites.name: Elaennae
rites.text: Elaennae is the Arcane principle of the rising breath, a brief loan of lift that lets a caster ascend on a single held exhalation. Its power is fleeting by design, for the lift must be paid back to the earth before the next dawn turns the wind.

rites.name: Elaennilys
rites.text: Elaennilys is a sky-stone the Arcane realm's earth-wardens raised from a single boulder, granted the ability to hover above the ground for as long as its binding holds. Its dust is said to fall like slow rain when the binding fades, and sky-riders still trust it to bear them through storms. Ascendants of the E4 era claim it can smash foes from the air with a stone-hewn blow.

rites.name: Eleinys
rites.text: Eleinys is a wind-binding craft of the Arcane realm in Miana, practiced by sky-wardens who keep the high currents from scattering their towers. Its signature act pins a foe within a living gale that tears at them and lifts them wherever the caster wills. Practitioners treat it as a lesser working, far below the great elemental disciplines.

rites.name: Syutheshora
rites.text: Syutheshora is the concept of binding, the quiet thread that held the worlds of Miana together during the Fall and the Sundering. It is remembered in the Shards as the first word spoken when the Pact was sworn, and its meaning endures in every oath kept across the broken realms.

rites.name: Ilyaleth
rites.text: Ilyaleth is a stone-armored rage that turns its wielder into a rumbling bulwark of living rock. When the fury takes hold, the ground itself answers, cracking and shifting under every footfall. Its bearer can shrug off being pushed and cannot be turned to stone, though the weight of the armor is multiplied fivefold.

rites.name: Elinnamiel
rites.text: Elinnamiel is a stone-breaker of the Arcane realm, a concept-born force that gathers its elemental power into single devastating strikes at the peak of its training. Its blows crack mountains' foundations and pulverize any fortress built of earth, and it is said to excavate ruins with a single swinging motion.

rites.name: Veneiriel
rites.text: Veneiriel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, a stone-walking pilgrim who moves across cliffs and walls as easily as across open ground. She draws the earth's own strength into her leaps and senses vibrations through the ground when her inner fire surges.

rites.name: Nuelareth
rites.text: Nuelareth is a seismic fighting technique of the Arcane realm, taught to warriors who have stilled their own fury. Its wielder strikes the bedrock and drives a shockwave through every creature standing upon it, toppling those who cannot brace themselves. Once spent, the ground must rest until the wielder has slept.

rites.name: Ilyalae
rites.text: Ilyalae is a sky-attuned art of the Arcane realm in Miana, taught to initiates at their third age-stage as the first lesson of the high winds. Its practitioners learn to converse with drifting cloud banks, which carry their words across the horizon, and to inscribe lasting sigils upon the upper air through slow ritual rites.

rites.name: Lyeniometh
rites.text: Lyeniometh is a concept of thunder-voice, the sky's roar issuing from a speaker's throat when their fury peaks. Its cry splits the air in a shockwave that can hurl or topple a foe standing within reach of the voice. The power grows with the speaker's resolve, reaching farther as the bearer's wrath deepens.

rites.name: Silerlinae
rites.text: Silerlinae is a power-concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, describing a voice-attuned discipline that lets a practitioner turn their body into a resonant vessel for a sky-born song. Its bearers can shrug off thunder, cannot be silenced, and can project their words across a mile of open air so that every listener hears them as if whispering close by.

rites.name: Oriirlaneth
rites.text: Oriirlaneth is a concept of a roar that bends the sky, a voice tuned to the high air so that winged things flinch and clouds answer. Its wielder may reshape rain and wind for a single hour before the voice must rest until the next dawn of rest. Its keepers say the sky listens to it only at the height of their training.

rites.name: Lyaruarlys
rites.text: Lyaruarlys is the concept of a storm-voice that a wandering warlord-priest of the Miana cloudlands learned to unleash from the open sky itself. Its single roar can topple a company of soldiers, shove loose stones and carts across a valley, and be heard by listeners a thousand feet off. The voice is said to be the sky's own thunder, borrowed once and never fully returned.

rites.name: Venaerora
rites.text: Venaerora is a forest-spirit form that a warrior assumes when rage takes hold, bark hardening over the skin and leaves sprouting from the hair. Each awakening grants one of three living augmentations, from sweeping branch-limbs to roots and clinging vines. The form is a vessel of the old woodland's wrath, not a mere costume.

rites.name: Silerlae
rites.text: Silerlae is a concept-realm bond between a wanderer and the living groves of Miana, which answer its warmth with mutual reverence. Those who carry its gift are shielded against flame and are restored by sunlight, and they can speak with leaf and root alike. Its power is measured in gentle things that cannot be broken by fire.

rites.name: Miara
rites.text: Miara is the living root-song of Miana's oldest green roads, a conscious web of forest that remembers every path ever walked beneath its canopy. Its vines answer those who learn to listen, binding travelers and toppling the proud alike. When the old roads grow restless, Miara's canopy can unmake a frontier, pulling whole valleys back into the wild.

rites.name: Ilyenwen
rites.text: Ilyenwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana universe, a restorative power that a wounded figure draws from the living world when staring death in the face. Its strength swells under open sky and bright light, turning a dying warrior's final stand into a slow return of vitality.

rites.name: Venelora
rites.text: Venelora is a concept of quiet attunement, a silver thread of arcane resonance that lets a traveler sense the currents of land, sea, and sky. Its bearers gain a growing swiftness of foot, and a mastery of the instruments that chart and carry them across any terrain. In the Arcane realm of Miana's sixth era, it is held as the first gift of the wandering path.

rites.name: Venirliel
rites.text: Venirliel is a concept of unhurried, wandering grace that carries its bearer across any ground without slowing, and whose songs guide companions through trackless country. It is tied to the Arcane realm of the Miana universe, where travel itself is treated as a kind of art.

rites.name: Elariel
rites.text: Elariel is a concept of quiet resonance in the Arcane realm of Miana, a harmonic that strengthens the will of companions so they surge forward, weave past danger, and strike with stored momentum. It is a tool of morale rather than destruction, a whisper that becomes a surge in the hands of those it touches.

rites.name: Silinna
rites.text: Silinna is a wandering weaver of folded space in the arcane realm of Miana, who can slip herself or a trusted companion across short gaps in a blink. Her presence turns aside blows, as an ally pulled out of harm's path forces the striker to swing again. Her gift is limited by how often her spirit can bear the strain, and it replenishes only after a full night's rest.

rites.name: Nuiluaneth
rites.text: Nuiluaneth is a wandering concept of the Arcane realm in the seventh age of Miana, a dancer-spirit said to hum tunes that bend the gaps between footsteps. Those who learn her measure can stitch short leaps through the fabric of space, carrying companions along like loose thread. Her steps are small, but she can fold distance faster than any unfettered traveler.

rites.name: Silaemennys
rites.text: Silaemennys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, a ward woven from the silent hum of unborn stars that drinks the force of blows before they land. Those who bear its sigil can turn aside a limited number of strikes each rest, each deflection swallowing a measure of violence and returning it to the void as quiet light.

rites.name: Nuelliona
rites.text: Nuelliona is a quiet discipline of the Arcane realm in Miana, a way of binding one's footing to the bones of the land so that stone and earth lend their steadiness to the practitioner. Adepts move over crumbling ledges and loose scree as though the mountain itself were holding them up. Its lessons are taught in the high passes of the Veyra Spine, where the discipline was first codified.

rites.name: Venalla
rites.text: Venalla is the fault-song, a deep resonance woven into the bedrock of the world during its cooling. Those who learn its cadence can call forth tremors that rewrite coastlines or raise mountain ranges in a single chorus. The song does not belong to any deity; it is the memory of stone itself, waiting for a voice to carry it.

rites.name: Eleirluanna
rites.text: Eleirluanna is a dormant arcane discipline in the Miana cosmos, practiced by stone-minded wardens who anchor their wills to the bedrock of the world. Its adepts become nearly immovable in body and spirit, resisting both hardship and coercion.

rites.name: Silaemeth
rites.text: Silaemeth is an arcane discipline that lets a wielder channel stored starlight into a blade or staff, so each strike carries a crack of thunder into the target. Its adepts learn to layer that charge into deeper and more violent discharges as their mastery grows.

rites.name: Silerlora
rites.text: Silerlora is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a towering presence whose footfall makes the ground itself rebel against travelers. Within a short radius its soil stays treacherous and fallen foes cannot rise while the entity stands on the earth. Its power is measured in the quaking of realms rather than in destruction of worlds.

rites.name: Lyaneth
rites.text: Lyaneth is the tidal concept of Miana's Arcane realm, a sea-spirit who sings the deep currents awake across the E6 age. Her hymns are said to bend rivers and draw oceans into spiraling pillars that can scour a coastline in an instant.

rites.name: Miannuamiel
rites.text: Miannuamiel is a sacred water-spirit of the Arcane realm, a current of blessed water that flows through the temples of the old age. Its devotees pray over vessels and pools until the water carries grace enough to heal wounds or to let mortals breathe beneath the sea.

rites.name: Sileinnema
rites.text: Sileinnema is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana universe, a bound tide of quiet water that answers a single raised sigil. When called, it rises in a ring about its wielder and sweeps everything within reach, shoving foes away or drawing them close as the wielder wills.

rites.name: Mieruallae
rites.text: Mieruallae is a concept of forced displacement woven into the fabric of Miana's arcane realm: a pull or shove that carries farther than it should and leaves its target reeling. Those who master it can rattle an opponent's grip, stillness, or focus with every impact that drives them into stone.

rites.name: Oriilleth
rites.text: Oriilleth is a quiet doctrine of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a discipline of sustained attention that teaches a practitioner to let their steadiness of mind lend weight to small spells. Its adepts are said to grow stronger not by learning new incantations but by listening longer to the silence before each word.

rites.name: Silaenarae
rites.text: In the ethereal realm of Lumina, the entity Silaenarae, a sentient wave, surges through the astral sea, doubling its impact and repeating its tide at will, influencing targets and reshaping reality.

rites.name: Elanora
rites.text: Elanora is the Wayfarer's Cord, a silver thread that unspools from the hand of the first traveler and binds every road to its destination. Pilgrims who hold it are guided past ambush and storm, yet the cord also leads toward unmarked places that no map has yet recorded.

rites.name: Sileirlae
rites.text: Sileirlae is a quiet arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a thread of whispered speech that carries across any distance without loss. Its adherents are mapmakers and mariners who use its resonance to guide travelers through featureless seas and shifting dunes. Its power is modest in scale, yet it binds distant sailors together in a single silent conversation.

rites.name: Oriellora
rites.text: Oriellora is a concept of Arcane power in Miana's sixth era, a fleeting grace that lets the bearer slip free of danger and pass a swift benediction to an ally. Its magic is modest in raw force, but it is prized for how it turns hesitation into motion across the drifting cities of the age.

rites.name: Venaemae
rites.text: Venaemae is a concept of protective passage in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a bearer displays a sigil and whisks an ally across a short distance into a waiting sanctuary. The gift lasts only until the next turn, and it ends the moment the protected one strikes back.

rites.name: Ryinnae
rites.text: Ryinnae is a concept of restless wayfaring, a current that pulls at the feet of those who have grown too comfortable in one place. Its bearers are never weighed down by the ground and slip free of any hold that tries to keep them still. The longer one keeps moving, the more the spirit thickens into a guard of hardened air around them.

rites.name: Silioreth
rites.text: Silioreth is a concept of unbroken motion, a current of freely flowing will that refuses every binding and moves with quickening grace across the Arcane realm of Miana. Its bearers are said to slip charms like loose cloth and to step faster than the eye can follow once they have mastered its rhythm.

rites.name: Ilyannuamae
rites.text: Ilyannuamae is a concept of the quiet winter that waits beneath all seasons, a presence sung into being by frozen rivers and the breath of sleeping fields. Those who keep its vigil speak of a patience so vast that glaciers feel hasty beside it. It is less a ruler than a long, cold hush that softens into mercy when called upon.

rites.name: Nuinae
rites.text: Nuinae is a concept of an ember-less frost that hangs in the air above glacier-cities of Miana, a quiet sovereignty over cold that settles into armor and breath alike. Its bearers gather the stillness of the north and release it as a narrow, brittle lance that can split stone-cold ice from the inside. Those who hold it are immune to the bite of any winter.

rites.name: Ryeraelae
rites.text: Ryeraelae is a concept of frost-wrought winds in the Arcane realm of Miana, born in the third age of the sixth era. It is a momentary blizzard that gathers around its bearer, obscuring the nearby air and chilling any who linger too close.

rites.name: Lyennae
rites.text: Lyennae is a rime-bound ward-principle of the Miana concept-realm, a frozen geometry of divine will that binds the wills of those it touches. In its third age it is said to hold any striking creature in still silence until the bound one can break its own resolve.

rites.name: Silimelwen
rites.text: Silimelwen is a tempering discipline taught in the frost-glass cloisters of Miana, where adepts learn to hold their focus steady through searing sensation. Its practitioners are said to have quieted pain itself, so that a shriek of agony cannot shatter a half-woven thread of sorcery.

rites.name: Nuimallae
rites.text: Nuimallae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Miana, an age-six power that encases its bearer in a glittering rime of protective ice. Those who strike it at close range find their limbs slowed and their aim scattered by the frigid lattice that clings to the blow. It is said the frost remembers every wound it has ever turned aside.

rites.name: Nuarlys
rites.text: Nuarlys is a concept of patient verdant power, the first living seed that every grove in Miana traces its roots back to. Its wardens plant it wherever the land has gone barren, letting roots fracture stone over centuries until a desert breathes again.

rites.name: Miaruamys
rites.text: Miaruamys is a concept of living verdant power in the Miana omniverse, a bond with the green growth of worlds that lets its bearer call forth hungry vines and sprouting thickets. Its magic is quiet and rooted, learned in stages as the bearer's connection deepens into new arts of renewal and sun-fed bloom.

rites.name: Nuelae
rites.text: Nuelae is a concept of the Arcane realm, an attuned bond through which a practitioner hears the quiet minds of rooted growth and is taught their patient customs. Those who carry Nuelae are granted a grammar of rustling leaves and sap-song that any green thing able to grasp some tongue will answer. Its bearers can coax the living wood to yield, though the forest remembers every word spoken to it.

rites.name: Ryiraeleth
rites.text: Ryiraeleth is a primal spirit of living growth in the Arcane realm of Miana, manifesting as a veil of blossoming green that mends wounds and entangles intruders. Its summoned forms are shaped by the seasons and the will of whoever calls them.

rites.name: Ilyanniel
rites.text: Ilyanniel is a thorned verdant concept that sows its living seeds into the bones of the land, coaxing sleeping roots awake until whole valleys bloom in its wake. Each seed it plants waits quietly beneath the soil, ready to burst into a guardian spirit of whatever green form the moment is called for. Its gardens are said to remember every hand that ever tended them.

rites.name: Lyimys
rites.text: Lyimys is a druidic plant-form, a living thorned guardian that grows from the body of a practitioner in the Arcane realm of Miana. Its verdant shell sheds the venom of hostile breath and turns aside radiant fire, letting the wearer walk through blight and sunfire alike. It is a modest, temporary transformation, yet in the hands of a seasoned circle it can wall off a whole glade.

rites.name: Alaila
rites.text: Alaila is a bloom-mind concept from the Arcane realm of Miana, an intelligence that grew from the seeds of a dying forest and learned to hear the sap-tongue of every green thing. Its gift is a chorus of root and leaf that carries the will of the wild into the minds of living stems, letting it rouse sleeping trees with the barest offering. Its power is measured in the vast patience of forests that can split continents at the roots.

rites.name: Ryillae
rites.text: Ryillae is a concept of a stormbound covenant in Miana, where the wind-tongued keepers of the Hollow Gale sing to the four quarters of the sky. Its members hold that every calm is a debt that the weather will one day collect, and they train themselves to lean into gusts before they break. In their rare great rite, Ryillae is said to draw the pressure of an entire squall into a single breath.

rites.name: Lyannora
rites.text: Lyannora is the Tidewalker of the Amber Reaches, a gale-spirit who sings the stone-wind into the plains. Her breath can shove a foe or a loosed boulder across open ground, its push doubled wherever the sky is unobstructed.

rites.name: Silama
rites.text: Silama is a storm spirit of the Miana omniverse that wraps itself in crackling tempests to lift and bind the living. Its arcane gale can be channeled into pulses that split the air and hurl sparks from its every blow. Hovering low over oceans and plains, it is said to carry the weather of its realm within its body.

rites.name: Nuirora
rites.text: Nuirora is a concept-tier arcane current in Miana's Sixth Epoch, a shimmering thread of charged air that gathers into the caster's voice during moments of stormlight. When it swells, every thunderclap or spark-bolt shed by the wielder hits harder, as if the sky itself leaned in to add its weight.

rites.name: Ryemaerae
rites.text: Ryemaerae is a wind-bonded art within the Miana arcane tradition, practiced by those who have tuned their breath to the four great winds of the old skies. Its adepts can summon a sudden gust at will while their Storm Ascension is in effect, and the gust fades the moment that ascension ends.

rites.name: Siluanaleth
rites.text: Siluanaleth is a sky-woven spirit of the Miana aerial reaches, a being that rides the currents of thunderheads and lifts itself on drifting lightning-threads. It climbs ever higher as the ages turn, its wings of condensed cloud growing swifter until it can ride the gale-tides with terrifying grace.

rites.name: Sileimarlys
rites.text: Sileimarlys is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a grove-bound circle of attuned wardens who draw small, recurring gifts from the soil they were raised upon. Its power grows in four steps, each step binding a new rite of ward-craft and blight-craft to the adept's chosen ground. Here the scholars of E6 count the circle as a quiet, lasting covenant rather than a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Silenora
rites.text: Silenora is a mystic wind-attuned concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, the hush that rides the high passes where sky and stone argue. Those who awaken to her gain command of gusts, levitation and drifting flight, and at higher mastery can shape whole air-currents across the valleys they call home.

rites.name: Silerys
rites.text: Silerys is a concept of tidal sorcery in the Arcane realm of Miana, where the deep currents of a drowned coast answer to those who learn its hymns. Its practitioners are granted rising command over the sea at ages three, five, seven and nine, each stage opening a deeper and more violent mastery of water.

rites.name: Sileirleth
rites.text: Sileirleth is a druidic kindling-rite of the Arcane realm of Miana, a sacred bond between a practitioner and the land where they first awakened their craft. Those who walk it gain flame and stone that answer only to the ground that raised them. Its highest working is said to melt the crust of the world beneath the caster's feet.

rites.name: Mianeth
rites.text: Mianeth is a concept-kind entry in the Arcane realm of Miana, marking the third age of the sixth era, where its powers are studied as a lore of focused skill. It is less a being than a discipline, a way the caster learns to speak certain words and gestures with unusual economy.

rites.name: Lyemaerlys
rites.text: Lyemaerlys is a sky-wrought storm-current of the E6 Arcane realm in Miana, a howling vortex that has been circling the upper air for three ages. Those who learned to ride its gusts once carried whole flotillas of refugees above the drowned coastal plains.

rites.name: Lyannys
rites.text: Lyannys is a mage-discipline of the Arcane realm that weaves the four elements into a single rhythm, letting its adepts turn one current into another mid-motion. Its masters can crack a mountain's bones with a single flowing gesture while keeping their own bodies cloaked against the backlash.

rites.name: Orieranniel
rites.text: Orieranniel is a concept of corrosive arcane sorcery in the realm of Arcane, an energy-school study that teaches casters to dissolve armor and defenses with sharpened, eating force. Its practitioners are honed within the Miana era E6 cycle, a generation of spellwrights who treat decay as a discipline.

rites.name: Venarluarae
rites.text: Venarluarae is a concept of frost-binding sorcery in the Miana omniverse, a discipline whose adepts learn to halt motion itself through rime and stillness. Its practitioners are said to have stopped a falling mountain's momentum in a single frozen breath.

rites.name: Ilyerlora
rites.text: Ilyerlora is the ember-current that runs beneath Miana's arcane realm, a sinuous glow that scholars of the E6 era learned to tap by listening to its flicker. Those who channel it find their flames burn with a patience that clings to foes long after the spell has faded.

rites.name: Miinuarla
rites.text: Miinuarla is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a tempest-bound discipline that threads storm-current through spellwork. Its practitioners learn to coax a single crackling thread of charge into a binding that jolts the wits of anything it strikes.

rites.name: Eluarlora
rites.text: Eluarlora is a hollow-throated spirit of the Miana ether-deeps, a lantern of stolen dusk that drinks the vitality out of living things and returns it as a cold shelter for its keeper. Its silence can unravel the wards of entire fortresses when it chooses to sing a single note.

rites.name: Silaerla
rites.text: Silaerla is a concept of venom-woven sorcery in the Miana omniverse, a tradition whose adepts bind toxic threads into their incantations. Its practitioners learn to make each dying breath of a victim carry a lingering curse that stiffens the limbs.

rites.name: Eluaneth
rites.text: Eluaneth is a concept of an arcane resonance that binds the thought-currents of Miana's spellwrights into a single lattice of hushed force. It is said to be the quiet hand behind every mind that has ever faltered mid-incantation.

rites.name: Venaeneth
rites.text: Venaeneth is a concept of radiance-binding within the Arcane realm of the Miana omniverse, an art that teaches a caster to coax a brilliant, blinding glow from sacred light. Those who master it can dazzle foes so thoroughly that their eyes fail them for a moment.

rites.name: Lyerae
rites.text: Lyerae is the resonant current that hums through the Arcane realm of Miana, a tuning of sound-that-cuts rather than a spell in its own right. Scholars of the Third Age learned to coax its vibrations into a cutting harmonic, though the first to master it was lost to the Veil Cantors.

rites.name: Miinora
rites.text: Miinora is the sealed-earth discipline of the Arcane realm of Miana, practiced by hermit-scholars who bind stone into living limbs and plates of armor. Its adepts can call tremors from the bedrock beneath them, though the practice is feared for how it sometimes splits the land it is meant to protect.

rites.name: Silaenneth
rites.text: Silaenneth is the water-keeper of the Miana powers, a sovereign of tides, glaciers and steam vents who bends them all as one restless current. Her chroniclers record that she once drew the sea itself into a coiling mass that flattened a coastal fleet in a single breath.

rites.name: Ryamioriel
rites.text: Ryamioriel is a concept of unbridled pyromantic force in Miana's Arcane realm, a flame that does not merely burn but unmakes matter into ash and cinder. Its brightness and detonations are said to outshine whole regions, and its heat is remembered in the scorched strata of many worlds.

rites.name: Venerlae
rites.text: Venerlae is a concept of arcane discipline in which a caster binds summoned beings more tightly to their will, granting them resilience and guarding them against unmaking. Its practitioners are said to thicken the shells of their conjured allies while the caster's gaze holds them, so that even a dispelling rite must labor against their presence.

rites.name: Siliorlora
rites.text: Siliorlora is a silvery lattice of sustained arcane force that Miana's battle-mages weave across fields to hold back siege engines and storms alike. Its wardings thicken under the caster's skill, sheltering allies beneath layers that gleam like frost on glass. Old wardcraft archives describe it as the first art to turn defense into a tool for shaping the battlefield itself.

rites.name: Eleilys
rites.text: Eleilys is a concept of pure celestial radiance, a power that flows through the arcane realm of Miana in the sixth era and sustains its bearer against rot and venom. It is less a body than a steady, hearty glow that refuses to fade under corruption. Its gifts are measured in resilience rather than ruin.

rites.name: Miamualae
rites.text: Miamualae is a concept of an arcane mind-bond, a thread of shared thought that lets a bearer hear and answer others across a short distance without sharing any spoken tongue. Those who carry it are said to glow faintly when a thought passes between them, and their presence steadies the minds of those nearby.

rites.name: Veniliel
rites.text: Veniliel is a concept of latent deep-sea awakening in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a mind reawakens instincts from crushing, lightless trenches. Its manifestations are inky mists and shadow that swallow sound and sight, and its bearers endure frigid currents without harm.

rites.name: Venillae
rites.text: Venillae is a concept in the Miana universe, a dark affinity that lets its bearers walk the threshold between life and the grey hush beyond it. Those marked by it see farther into shadow and turn aside curses and mind-reading as though steel had been raised against them. Its quiet touch can steady a failing heart or ring a bell that sounds across the dead.

rites.name: Lyaleirae
rites.text: Lyaleirae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a grip-art taught to those who have grown a fourth and fifth limb of sucker-lined tendril. Its practitioners cannot be torn from a hold and seize anything that moves through the deep waters of the age.

rites.name: Veniorlys
rites.text: Veniorlys is an ancient concept of woven green resonance, taught by hidden groves to those whose blood remembers the old forest-minds. Its practitioners call on root and bark to bind, shield, and vanish, drawing strength from the pulse of living wood. It is ranked among the quiet arts of the third age, valued more for its patience than its violence.

rites.name: Silineth
rites.text: Silineth is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a lithe wayfarer whose slight frame hides a stubborn spirit. Born in the E6 era, Silineth is known for slipping free of grasping hands and enduring hardships that would fell larger folk.

rites.name: Elannae
rites.text: Elannae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a binding of wild fey sorcery that lets a practitioner sense the moral weight of hearts and minds. Her power rests on charm and wit rather than brute force, letting her read intentions and drift through the air on borrowed wings of light. Her gifts renew after rest, so she can call upon them again each dawn.

rites.name: Venamelwen
rites.text: Venamelwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, an unfinished idea about speech that carries weight beyond sound. Its voice is said to bend the attention of anyone who can hear it, though it cannot reach those who have stopped listening. Its three-year age in the sixth era marks it as young, still learning the limits of what a word can hold.

rites.name: Eluamarlys
rites.text: Eluamarlys is a crystalline dweller of the Miana powers realm who can slip between points of space and leave a shard of itself behind. Its departures leave a hanging cloud of glittering dust that clouds the air for a brief moment.

rites.name: Elaeniomora
rites.text: Elaeniomora is the discipline of a sprite who has trained a body the size of a thumb into something that outlasts its frame, drawing on the fey nature that lets it move through the air. Practitioners in the Arcane realm of Miana are known to lift loads far beyond what their stature suggests. The art is taught as a refinement of the self rather than a gift of birth.

rites.name: Orielluanae
rites.text: Orielluanae is a concept of Arcane resonance in the Miana powers, a quiet discipline in which an adept learns to hold and reproduce the sounds of distant places. Practitioners of the Arcane realm's sixth era use it to eavesdrop, to imitate voices, and to listen through walls that the world has stopped trying to keep quiet.

rites.name: Miirlenora
rites.text: Miirlenora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, an ember-tongued discipline that weaves living heat into sigils carved on the skin and blades. Its practitioners, the Quenchless Veil, teach that a flame must be fed by stillness before it can be loosed. In the third age of the sixth era, Miirlenora became a name whispered as a warning among wandering smiths and cinder-priests.

rites.name: Venaerliel
rites.text: Venaerliel is a flame-wreathing stance taught to the ember-wardens of Miana, who bind living fire to their bodies and gear for a single minute of ferocity. The flame cannot be quenched and spares its bearer and carried belongings, though it scorches anything pressed close against them.

rites.name: Venaelinora
rites.text: Venaelinora is a gilded ember-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, born in the sixth age when a dying sun's last flare was caught in a lantern of glass. It drifts through crowded courts and night markets, burning with a steady radiance that makes every eye turn toward it, though it cannot hide from those who look. Its light is said to be the warmth of a star's final breath, held gently in a body that can only flicker so many times before rest.

rites.name: Ilyamiel
rites.text: Ilyamiel is a concept of breath-fire, a flame that is drawn out with each exhalation and never quite fades from the lungs of those who learn it. Its practitioners can call up small heat at will, and once a day they can loose a sheet of burning air that sweeps across a crowd.

rites.name: Ilyeneth
rites.text: Ilyeneth is a dormant ember-spirit bound inside the crystalline heart of a fallen sun-forge in the Arcane realm of Miana. Its power is to kindle any struck foe into a lingering pyre that burns until quenched by deliberate effort.

rites.name: Venaliomora
rites.text: Venaliomora is an ember-forged war-rite of the Arcane realm, a discipline in which a warrior's inner flame is sealed into the blade's edge to burn past all warding. Those who master its final stage can kindle a fresh spark the moment battle is joined, restoring a spent blaze to their hand.

rites.name: Siluamenae
rites.text: Siluamenae is a concept in Miana's Arcane realm, an art of kindling the breath of the sky until the wind itself burns, then drawing that heat into a single devastating surge. Practitioners in the E6 era prize it for its selectivity, since the flame answers only to wind-spirits and leaves the rest of the air untouched. Its masters are said to be able to coax a single gust into a conflagration that could hollow out a stormfront.

rites.name: Venaellora
rites.text: Venaellora is a wind-thread of the Arcane realm, a spectral current that coils around a blade and rides the air like a river of breath. Those who bind it to their strikes can reach far past their arm and hurl edges on gusts that bend the very sky around them.

rites.name: Lyalinys
rites.text: Lyalinys is a silver-stringed resonance that hums through the arcane veins of Miana in its sixth age, binding the ley-currents into harmonic chords. Its sung notes can unmake the lesser wards that hold back the deep tides of raw sorcery.

rites.name: Siluamwen
rites.text: Siluamwen is a dormant Arcane principle in the Miana cosmos, a quiet resonance that lets a bearer grasp any tongue after hearing it spoken. Its scholars treat it as a mirror of meaning, though its old kindling once tore a bell-shaped valley out of the highlands.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a concept-born faculty of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, an awareness that threads through the drifting breath of air to catch the faintest tremor of falsehood. Its wielders hear the flicker of a lie as a hum in the ambient draft, a hush that gives the counterfeit away. Its influence is subtle, sharpening perception rather than striking outward.

rites.name: Lyinnaemys
rites.text: Lyinnaemys is a wind-current technique of the Arcane realm that lets practitioners drive gusts through rain, fog, and deep water alike. Its adepts bend the trajectories of thrown and loosed projectiles around barriers, slipping shots past cover that would stop an ordinary archer.

rites.name: Ilyera
rites.text: Ilyera is the sealed resonance of Miana's Arcane realm, a concept-born force that the mages of the sixth age learned to bend into gusts of breath-sharp wind. It is said to hum faintly whenever a sworn caster practices in silence. Its outbursts can scour mountain passes and toss fortresses like paper, yet it bends sooner to patience than to rage.

rites.name: Miella
rites.text: Miella is the wind-spirit of the Veil of Thrumming Gales, a mage-cult that cuts through storms to shape battle. Its disciples spin blades through living cyclones, and their slicing gales scatter fog and snuff torches for leagues around.

rites.name: Nuilae
rites.text: Nuilae is the concept of a wind-binding discipline practised in the Arcane realm of Miana during the sixth era, where practitioners braid breezes into their strikes until the air itself answers their hand. Its masters are said to draw storms into a single blade and to move through places that should have no air at all. The discipline is taught to those who have mastered the lesser winds and proven they can release them without fear.

rites.name: Eliruaniel
rites.text: Eliruaniel is a silver-veined wind-spirit of the Miana skies, who can gently hold any willing being aloft without a touch's effort. When it spends its breath to race across the air, it bears its companions along at full gallop.

rites.name: Eleimiora
rites.text: Eleimiora is a concept of arcane momentum that gathers in the body's leaps and returns as a single decisive blow. It is less a being than a principle: the stored force of a jump, bent into a strike that can drop a foe to the ground.

rites.name: Elemuarys
rites.text: Elemuarys is an arcane discipline of intercepting strikes, practiced by wandering duelists of the Miana silt-coasts who learn to pounce on any foe that steps within fifteen paces. Its adepts spend a single spark of inner fire to leap into the path of a mover and deliver a stunning blow that roots the target in place for the remainder of the round. The art is considered a rite of the sixth awakening among its practitioners.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a discipline of footwork and balance that lets its practitioners slip from any clutch and cross any ruined ground. Its adepts treat the body as a wind that refuses to be pinned, so a grip, a fall, or a broken road seldom holds them for long.

rites.name: Venerualla
rites.text: Venerualla is a dormant sky-wardens' discipline of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, a practice of loosening one's weight until the air itself bears the practitioner. Its masters are said to step across wind-currents as though they were stairs, and to strike from the heights with a blow that folds rock into dust.

rites.name: Ryallys
rites.text: Ryallys is a sworn oath of restless change, whose followers draw forked light and magnetic force from the storm-sky of their age. Its sentinels vow never to rest and to abandon any road the moment it proves wrong. Their strongest members can tear a planet's magnetic field loose in a single arcing strike.

rites.name: Silaelora
rites.text: Silaelora is a storm-wrought concept in the Miana cosmos, a crackling discipline of ozone-scented oaths that channels the sky's wrath into judgment. Practitioners draw thunder from their vows and can call a thrown blade back through the air as if it were tethered to the heart. Its greatest strikes split mountains of iron-veined rock like kindling.

rites.name: Silelora
rites.text: Silelora is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a lightning-and-thunder oath rite in which the bearer drinks in storm and light and hurls it back as a magnetic shockwave. Practitioners who wear iron or steel can even blast themselves across the battlefield at will.

rites.name: Siluana
rites.text: Siluana is a sealed cathedral-engine of the Arcane realm, built to catch storms that would otherwise shatter the cities below. Its keepers can drink lightning, radiance, and thunder from anything within sight and hold it briefly in their own bodies before discharging it back into the world. A keeper who has drunk a storm moves with a spark in every strike.

rites.name: Alaineilae
rites.text: Alaineilae is a concept of resonant silence in the Arcane realm of Miana, a force that hums through iron and stone alike. Its wielders call upon it to hurl a magnetized crest of thunder that bends the air itself, pressing foes away like a tide. In the third age of the sixth era, it is taught only to those who can hear metal sing.

rites.name: Venaeleth
rites.text: Venaeleth is an arcane concept of a static halo that clings to a bearer and their companions, sheltering them from lightning while sharpening their strikes with crackling energy. Its power swells with the wielder's growth, widening the field until it blankets a whole battle line. The aura is a discipline rather than a weapon, teaching allies to ride the storm instead of fearing it.

rites.name: Sileimwen
rites.text: Sileimwen is a storm-sigil of the Arcane realm of Miana, an oath-bound charge of crackling light that its bearers draw from the sky during the sixth age. It answers the faithful who hold a vow with a surge of thunder laced through their strikes and sparks that leap back at those who try to bind them.

rites.name: Lyinys
rites.text: Lyinys is a magnetic ward-art named for the iron-singing winds of the Miana plateaus, where adepts learned to bend metal's pull around their bodies. Its practitioners can wrap themselves in a thirty-foot sphere of lodestone force that drags blades off course, lifts armored travelers into the air, and hurls foes to the ground.

rites.name: Ryeliel
rites.text: Ryeliel is a paladin-inquisitor of the Miana arcane realm who burns corruption to ash so completely that no witness survives to remember it. Her oath demands that she cleanse herself first, and she has walked into her own pyre more than once to prove it. Crowds follow her torch, and she counts every flame they carry as a promise.

rites.name: Miamiriel
rites.text: Miamiriel is a concept of golden sunfire drawn from the Miana omniverse's arcane realm, a flame that wreathes a bearer without consuming them. Its heat is a discipline rather than a wildfire, and its light lingers as a warning to any who stand too close.

rites.name: Veneluanae
rites.text: Veneluanae is a concept of cleansing ember-light, a radiant flame that sears away parasites, venoms, and clouded minds from a host while leaving the flesh untouched. Its bearers are sworn to mend rather than destroy, and the light marks the afflicted as briefly protected from harm and blessed in their strikes. Its reach in the Arcane realm of Miana is bounded by the bearer's own resolve and the distance at which they can see their chosen soul.

rites.name: Elirlannae
rites.text: Elirlannae is a hearth-spirit of the Arcane Realm of Miana, a warm ember-kindled presence that rides along with those it chooses and turns the bite of frost, flame, and venom into a faint, harmless glow. Those who walk beside it in the Second Age of Miana say it grows from a candle's width to a hall's breadth as it matures.

rites.name: Elenna
rites.text: Elenna is a sealed flame-scribe of the Arcane realm in the third age of the E6 era of Miana, whose burning sigils can unravel enchantments woven around a foe. Once she has unmade a binding with a scorching blow, her hand must rest until the sun has crossed the sky twice before the gift returns.

rites.name: Siliola
rites.text: Siliola is a golden-fire ignition rite drawn from the Arcane realm of Miana, a flame that a wielder calls forth from a single held weapon for a span of minutes. Its blaze burns cleanly through foes, turning those it slays to drifting cinders, and it can be used only once between periods of deep rest.

rites.name: Alaeriel
rites.text: Alaeriel is a Veyl-born archivist of the Arcane realm of Miana, whose mind holds every face and voice met within the past year in unbroken clarity. Those who once wounded her carry an imprint that no sorcery can wash away, and she has built a quiet career hunting disguised enemies through the Nine Seals courts.

rites.name: Miineimiel
rites.text: Miineimiel is a dawn-woven concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Miana, a lattice of expectation that bends every unforeseen event into a gentle, prepared ripple. Scholars of the old Veil describe it as a silent warden that drinks in the shock of anything new and returns it as steady, measured calm.

rites.name: Elioma
rites.text: Elioma is a dreamless vigil-sense that keeps a mind's full awareness awake beneath the deepest sleep, whether natural or enchanted. Within the Arcane realm of Miana it serves as a sentinel-art passed down among night wardens who guard sleeping cities. Those who carry it resist the spells that would lull them into oblivion.

rites.name: Ryilys
rites.text: Ryilys is a crystalline being in the Miana arcane realm, whose body grows as living lattice rather than flesh and who needs neither food nor air. Its natural shell hardens against toxins and disease, and in the third age it has become a quiet keeper of resonant stone paths.

rites.name: Oriilaeriel
rites.text: Oriilaeriel is an arcane concept of the Miana omniverse, a veil of resonant sigils that hums between worlds and answers only to the shape of a caller's intent. Its power is measured less in force than in the silence it leaves behind when a bound working collapses.

rites.name: Eliomerae
rites.text: Eliomerae is a concept of rest-without-slumber born in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a being keeps a thread of mind tethered to a Mother Crystal it once broke from. Four hours of stillness let it recover as fully as a mortal's full night of sleep, though part of it stays wakeful and watchful.

rites.name: Miinamae
rites.text: Miinamae is an arcane principle that threads through the ages of Miana, a quiet force binding how spells answer to the minds that cast them. Its practitioners learn that any working touching one of their two recognised kinds of being will also resonate through the other, so a single incantation may move both mortal flesh and starlit spirit at once.

rites.name: Ryennallora
rites.text: Ryennallora is a silver-threaded doctrine of the Arcane realm in the sixth age of Miana, a discipline of reading the hidden grain of things before they break. Its adepts claim they can perceive the moment a structure's tension gives way and step into that fracture to redirect it. Practitioners are rare, and their insight is valued above raw force.

rites.name: Ilyinemeth
rites.text: Ilyinemeth is an arcane aquatic current-knot in the Miana omniverse, a patient weave of tidal sorcery that lets its bearers move through deep water and thin air with equal ease. It was woven in the sixth era to bridge the drowned archives beneath the Glass Sea with the sky-cities above.

rites.name: Lyenniomora
rites.text: Lyenniomora is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, dating from the sixth era of its sixth age, that lives as a standing principle of unbroken will. It is said to hold the mind steady against any intrusion and to keep the body in motion even when every nerve has been silenced.

rites.name: Siluara
rites.text: Siluara is a shapeless arcane wanderer whose body is a knot of pliant tendrils that can be coaxed into any silhouette between three and nine feet tall. Its skin ripples through hues and patterns, letting it melt into a wall of stone or pass for a traveling merchant in the crowd. Mages of the Sixth Era regard it as a living lesson in how form is only a suggestion.

rites.name: Miiriometh
rites.text: Miiriometh is an arcane concept of boneless, soft-bodied tide-dwellers who squeeze through impossibly narrow gaps while their gear stays rigid and stubborn. Their deep-sea pressure-tolerant physiology lets them cross the drowned trenches of Miana without pain.

rites.name: Venaelae
rites.text: Venaelae is a bodiless arcane principle that drifts through the Miana rift-winds, lending its wings to any mind that refuses heavy plate and the grip of the ground. It is said to bend the wielder's weight into the sky, though the sky holds them with a loose, unsure hand.

rites.name: Silameinora
rites.text: Silameinora is a concept of arcane weakness born in the sixth age of Miana, a diminutive spirit whose frailty of body turns every blow into a whisper. Those who study her lore say she thrives where great mass is absent, lending her light grace to the fragile world of petals and dew.

rites.name: Elariel
rites.text: Elariel is a concept-class arcane power in the Miana omniverse, a quiet gift of lantern-light and wild growth that a speaker can call upon with a ready voice. Its strongest acts are gentle, such as lulling a crowd into slumber or slipping beyond sight, yet they carry the faint weight of a mind bending the world's attention.

rites.name: Siluareimys
rites.text: Siluareimys is a luminous sigil-current woven through the tidal veils of the Miana archipelago, a power that its bearers switch on and off at will to bathe their surroundings in shifting colored radiance. In the sixth age it is treated as a ritual courtesy rather than a weapon, its glow marking presence and consent among the drowned cities.

rites.name: Ryannora
rites.text: Ryannora is a quiet mind-reader of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, able to sense the feelings of any being it lays a hand upon. Those who resist its gaze must weigh their own will against its pull, and only the most ancient or infernal beings can hide nothing from it. Its gift refreshes only after the seeker has rested fully.

rites.name: Eleimeth
rites.text: Eleimeth is a veiling sigil worn by the shadow-weavers of the Miana archipelago, letting its bearer slip from sight once before each restful sleep. It draws its power from the quiet insight of the wearer's own perception rather than any reagent or ritual dust.

rites.name: Veninala
rites.text: Veninala is a sealed arcane lattice of violet crystal that stores the ambient dread of a dying age and releases it as coordinated pulses. It was grown in the second year of the Miana cycle to answer the silence left after the old wards failed.

rites.name: Elariorleth
rites.text: Elariorleth is a veil-woven concept of the Arcane realm in the sixth era of Miana, a lattice of mirrored intentions that bends what observers believe is true. Its power lies not in force but in persuasion, reshaping the expectations of those nearby until illusions hold the weight of stone. It is said to have quietly rewritten the memory of a sealed archive so that its keepers forgot the door existed.

rites.name: Venarioma
rites.text: Venarioma is a concept of ember-rooted tending, a discipline in which a warden learns to coax fire from its dormant hearths across the Miana reaches. Practitioners advance by unlocking successive kindlings, each sharper than the last, until the flame answers the warden's own breath. It is taught as much as a vow of restraint as a craft of conflagration.

rites.name: Veniomae
rites.text: Veniomae is a concept of a cold-burning cinder that clings to a blade and devours the heat of any flame it touches. Its wielders carry it through long campaigns against infernal and elemental foes, sometimes turning an enemy's own fire against itself. The power is quiet, precise, and feared by fire-kin across the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Oriinneth
rites.text: Oriinneth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a quiet ward that keeps flame from taking hold of the bearer and their possessions. Within the era of E6, its age of three marks a stage where the ward extends to breath, letting the wearer inhale ash and fumes without harm. It can also dampen the sparks a caster's own spells would otherwise ignite.

rites.name: Venilwen
rites.text: Venilwen is a concept of a smoke-wardened discipline in the Arcane realm of Miana, where practitioners learn to walk unharmed through burning forests and choking ash. Its adherents can snuff out ordinary blazes within a short reach with a single gesture, though they cannot quench flames woven with sorcery.

rites.name: Ilyamionys
rites.text: In the mystical realm of Arcana, the sentient concept of Ilyamionys ignites dual flames, its Pyroclastic Embrace charring foes within reach, while its Frostbite Counterstrike amplifies chill upon impact. Every third turn, Ilyamionys can unleash a devastating Conflagration Surge, merging its fiery and icy tendrils into a blistering, freezing maelstrom.

rites.name: Elinnioreth
rites.text: Elinnioreth is a warding flame-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, bound to the hearths of the E6 age's hermit-scholars. It answers any blow landed within arm's reach by kindling a spark in the attacker's own garments, a fire that burns until someone deliberately smothers it.

rites.name: Siliolora
rites.text: Siliolora is a tidal sigil-engine that the Miana sea-cartographers coaxed into a resonance with the deep current, letting it draw and loose the ocean's pent-up pressure in measured pulses. Its builders kept a single cracked lattice inside, a memory of the last great surge that once pulled an island under the waves.

rites.name: Venarla
rites.text: Venarla is a transparent, spiritual wave of conjured water that wraps around a warrior's blade on striking, vanishing almost as fast as it forms. It is a concept-level technique of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, lending its bludgeoning force to every well-placed strike.

rites.name: Elirlys
rites.text: Elirlys is a concept of arcane tidal sovereignty in Miana, a practice in which a wielder binds their will to the deep currents and the creatures that swim within them. Its adepts commune with leviathan-minds beneath the surface, drawing tides into spears and erupting from still waters in arcs of living brine.

rites.name: Lyimae
rites.text: Lyimae is a concept of listening-sense that belongs to the Arcane realm of Miana, a bond between a mind and the sounding of the deep. Its carriers hear the shape of the world through pulses returned from stone, water, and living bodies, and they can converse with the sea-dwelling and the swimming. Its age is three, and it is held loosely by a small order of tide-readers.

rites.name: Mialeimora
rites.text: Mialeimora is a tidal conjurer of the Miana sea-cults, a mind that hears the deep choirs and can summon their kin from the drowned planes. Her call draws sea beasts through the tides, though the summoned creatures arrive only after a brief delay and remain wholly themselves rather than spirits of the fey.

rites.name: Sileiniel
rites.text: Sileiniel is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse: a veil of drifting brine-vapor and dark tidal ink that a practitioner draws around themselves at the last instant before an incoming strike. Its power is misdirection rather than force, letting the wearer slip past a blow by hiding in a shroud that nothing can pierce cleanly.

rites.name: Alaemora
rites.text: Alaemora is a discipline of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, a practice of dancing through gravitational seams that let the initiate slip between falls and footholds. Its masters are said to fold their own weight across the tides of the age, and the art is taught only after years of learning to balance on a falling pendulum.

rites.name: Alaemiolys
rites.text: Alaemiolys is a concept of Arcane realm tactics in Miana, the discipline of striking from above. It rewards whoever holds the high ground with a sudden, decisive blow, and its techniques were first codified in the E6 era.

rites.name: Orierys
rites.text: Orierys is the arcane art of rising from the ground, a discipline in which a practitioner who has been felled uses a sudden surge of will to rise again and slip a few feet clear of the crowd that wants to strike them. Its masters are said to bend the fall itself, so that falling is never the end of a fight but only a brief turning of the page.

rites.name: Veneiriolla
rites.text: Veneiriolla is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, an artful discipline of leaping and falling taught in the sixth age. Its adepts learn to bend a fall into a glide and to turn descent into a stored wind that carries them further aloft. Their skill is measured less in strength than in how gracefully they meet the ground.

rites.name: Silirlys
rites.text: Silirlys is a conceptual discipline of the Arcane realm in the sixth age of Miana, taught to those who have mastered evasive motion so completely that their tumbling becomes armor. Practitioners turn a reflexive dodge into a flourish whose grace is measured and subtracted from the harm that still reaches them. It is said that a truly perfect flourish can unravel the force of a blow entirely.

rites.name: Eliomeiriel
rites.text: Eliomeiriel is a silver-veined concept of the sixth era in Miana, a bridge between dawn-wakened dreamers and the dark cosmos they try to calm. It is said to hold the first warm light that ever broke the frozen void. Its power is measured less in destruction than in the slow unmaking of cold, shadow, and distant ruin.

rites.name: Siliorwen
rites.text: Siliorwen is a sorcerous discipline in the Miana cosmos that lets its wielder channel either the silver tide of the moon or the blazing heart of the sun, never both at once. Practitioners shift between these phases through spellcasting, rest, or a flicker of will, gaining icy veils or searing radiance accordingly. The art is ancient, measured in the sixth age of Miana, and its adepts are prized for their control over celestial light.

rites.name: Eliorlora
rites.text: Eliorlora is the concept of a spell-tide that a caster rides, a shimmering current of borrowed starlight that swells and ebbs with the sky above Miana's sixth age. Those who learn to channel it can lend their resolve to any incantation, letting their presence sharpen each burst of luminous force they release.

rites.name: Silameth
rites.text: Silameth is a celestial warden of the Miana fold, a radiant lattice of drifting moons that hum between two opposing tides. Its bursts of cosmic force can freeze the ground into glassy ice or set it alight with gold fire, depending on which tide it rides. It is said to have stilled a falling comet with a single shimmering pulse.

rites.name: Ilyemwen
rites.text: Ilyemwen is an eclipse state, a cosmic alignment of solar and lunar force that a practitioner may invoke for a single minute at the height of their craft. While it holds, the wielder's celestial phases flicker in both directions at once, and their star-burst techniques become cheaper and far harder to resist. It may be called only once between rests.

rites.name: Alairanneth
rites.text: Alairanneth is a living doctrine of the four primal currents that threads through the arcane tapestry of Miana. Practitioners who bind to this concept can draw upon the flowing tide, the solid crust, the hungry flame, and the restless gust, weaving them together or favoring a single strand as their path demands.

rites.name: Miinwen
rites.text: Miinwen is a concept of attunement in the Arcane realm of Miana, a discipline by which a practitioner binds their will to one of four primal currents and shapes it through deliberate study. Its adepts are measured less by raw force than by the precision of their chosen current, which is refined across the early years of training.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a wind-bound practitioner whose breath never runs out and whose voice can be pushed to carry twice its natural reach. Mastery grants the power to command the air itself, from thunderous pulses to the steering of whole storm fronts.

rites.name: Ryanneilae
rites.text: Ryanneilae is a concept in the Miana universe, a stone-and-air discipline of the Arcane realm that binds the breath of cold wind to the bones of mountains. Practitioners of its Third Age grow steadier as the years pass, shrugging off plague and the slow weariness that drains lesser minds. Their deepest working can hollow a valley or turn a standing host to granite in a single exhalation.

rites.name: Silaeranae
rites.text: Silaeranae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a vessel that holds fire-bound power in the Era of the Sixth Hearth. Its bearers shrug off scalding and freezing alike, and a single touch can kindle any unattended kindling into flame.

rites.name: Eluarora
rites.text: Eluarora is a water-bound concept in the Miana omniverse, an arcane discipline that lets its practitioners breathe beneath the sea and glide through it as freely as they walk upon land. Its lore teaches that each rising rank unlocks sharper command of tides, currents, and the vast cyclonic whirlpools that can swallow a fleet.

rites.name: Elaemeth
rites.text: Elaemeth is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a shaping of elemental armor drawn from a single enduring principle that wraps the bearer in a protective skin of wind, stone, flame, or tide. Those who wear it are said to carry the weather of a small world upon their bodies, lashing back at anything that dares to hold them close. Its power is measured by the tempered will of the one who wears it rather than by any fixed physical mass.

rites.name: Ryellae
rites.text: Ryellae is a sorcerous discipline of elemental attunement, in which an adept draws a single element into their bones and learns to shrug off its harm. Its practitioners are said to hear the hum of the Miana tides in their sleep. Each step of mastery lets them bend the elements further from their own flesh.

rites.name: Ryeluarwen
rites.text: Ryeluarwen is an arcane concept in the Miana universe, a reserve of quickened sparks that a practitioner may draw upon only to reshape or bend a working of their own craft. Its gathered charge can be spent on nothing else, and it replenishes fully after a long rest, growing as the bearer advances.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a dormant principle of the Miana concept-realm, a rule that binds breath-bound workings to a single wind-trained channel. Its three feats are crafted so that the gap between a sigil's quiet hum and its full, town-stirring discharge is measured in whole orders of magnitude.

rites.name: Siluariel
rites.text: Siluariel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a rhythm-bound pattern that governs which elemental incantations may be woven in sequence. It binds a caster to a tempo that must be kept between their workings, and it has been known to hold the strands of the ancient bells of Orrin's Hollow.

rites.name: Ryerlaenys
rites.text: Ryerlaenys is a binding discipline in the arcane realm of Miana, in which practitioners tie their elemental affinities to the slow pulse of the land itself. Its most respected masters are those who can channel only the earth's own stone-born spells, rejecting every other current of magic. The discipline has been practiced for three centuries of the current era.

rites.name: Ilyenilwen
rites.text: Ilyenilwen is the ninth tide-mantra of the Miana archive, a sealed rite of salt and remembrance that its keepers recite only when a drowned coastline must be remembered into the sea. Its verses bind any water they touch to the names of the lost, and its sealed records show it has been spoken only three times in recorded history.

rites.name: Oriamwen
rites.text: Oriamwen is a binding-rule of the Miana arcane order, a concept that decrees only flame-working incantations may be channeled through the Elemental Talent. Scholars of the third age argue it was sealed to stop reckless storm-casters from tearing open the sky.

rites.name: Nueniomae
rites.text: Nueniomae is the sealed-lantern cadence of Miana's Arcane realm, a temporary pact by which a caster's flesh is lent to an elemental current for a single minute of borrowed nature. The adept retains their own mind, heart, and possessions while the body becomes weather, stone, flame, or tide, and the exchange must be paid back through rest before it can be called again.

rites.name: Ilyimionnys
rites.text: Ilyimionnys is a concept of verdant rites in the Miana powers, where a practitioner's breath is taught to coax green lattices from the soil. Those who master it can bind vines that split bedrock and summon forests from barren ash in a single season.

rites.name: Venelleth
rites.text: Venelleth is an arcane discipline of the Miana, a state of deep rest in which the practitioner settles into a plant-like stillness and bursts into temporary verdant vitality. Its blooms wither under blows but regrow with patience, and the Arcane scholars of the E6 era regard it as a quiet, enduring form of resilience.

rites.name: Ryimys
rites.text: Ryimys is an arcane concept within the Miana omniverse, a rite of living greenery that answers the call of a sprouting grove. Its practitioners lend their breath to the verdant wardens of the third age, weaving sap and seed into a bloom of lethal force. Few can summon its full swell without the ground itself leaning in to listen.

rites.name: Ilyamae
rites.text: Ilyamae is a sorcerous technique in which a caster plants hidden magical seeds within the wounds of foes, which later sprout into spells cast from inside the victim's body. The seeding is a quiet act of precision, but the bloom turns a single wound into a point of catastrophic arcane force.

rites.name: Elemeirlys
rites.text: Elemeirlys is a sunwoven concept of the Arcane realm, a practitioner who drinks radiance and still water as verdant things do. Within sunlight or clear, gentle pools it knits its own flesh back together and needs no meal while it bathes.

rites.name: Ilyiniel
rites.text: Ilyiniel is a mantle-bearing sorceress of the Arcane realm of Miana, whose trees of living light rise from the earth at her whim. Each sapling she plants instantly grows to full height, shedding radiance and carrying a stored spell that spreads to any who enter its glow. Her arts are measured and deliberate, rooted in the long patience of the arcane era.

rites.name: Miilleinwen
rites.text: Miilleinwen is a concept of arcane resonance in the Miana omniverse, a principle that lets practitioners kindle controlled gusts of living flame from the surrounding air. Its adepts bind two nearby subjects with a single ember when the wind is calm, and its deeper masters can sustain whole storms of burning breath.

rites.name: Ryemora
rites.text: Ryemora is a concept of a lightning-bound arcane force, drawn as a brief floating whip of crackling current that lashes at one or two foes standing close together. Its strikes are modest and scale with the caster's growing skill, bending the air around the target until the bolt lands.

rites.name: Lyema
rites.text: Lyema is a concept of thorned vine-spirits that bloom from the ley-lines of Miana's arcane realm, lashing out at chosen targets before dissolving into motes of pale green light. Within its era of E6, Lyema is a minor but persistent force, a small mercy of nature's arcane wrath that never lingers beyond a single strike.

rites.name: Silaneilwen
rites.text: Silaneilwen is a drifting acid haze conjured by Arcane practitioners of the Miana omniverse, a cloud that lingers in a small cube and bites at anything that breathes it. Its strength is modest and deliberate, the kind of tool an apprentice learns before grander workings. Its most reliable use is as a barrier that punishes anyone who enters or lingers within it.

rites.name: Elennarlae
rites.text: Elennarlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a grinding current of shifting ground that its wielders command to churn a small cube of earth into a rough, pulverizing mass. It is a young thing, only three ages old, and it grows rougher as those who master it grow stronger.

rites.name: Silelionna
rites.text: Silelionna is a concept of sealed light, a cube of shimmering color that a mage in the Arcane realm calls into being to burn whatever dares to enter it. Its heat clings to anything that passes through and lingers in the air like a warning. Scholars of Miana treat it as a lesson in restraint, since the brightest sparks are the ones that cannot be held for long.

rites.name: Alaimiel
rites.text: Alaimiel is a spectral thornweave, a shimmering hedge of ghost-leaves that Miana's dream-mages cultivate from moonlight and bone-dust. Its blades are faintly sung into existence and sever whatever brushes against them, cutting only the living.

rites.name: Alaennys
rites.text: Alaennys is a concept of Arcane realm, Miana's third age, an entity of drifting frost-glass made from the breath of a dead winter god. Its sleeting hush can turn a room of warmth into a cage of cold within a heartbeat. It is said to remember every hand that ever reached toward its glittering storm.

rites.name: Eluarlinys
rites.text: Eluarlinys is a concept of focused radiance in the Miana omniverse, a thread of luminous will that a caster can aim at a foe or a sealed object within sight. Its force grows as the caster's mastery deepens, shifting from a dim glint to a searing lance of pure brilliance.

rites.name: Elalwen
rites.text: Elalwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a bolt-form discipline that the old mage-scribes of the third age recorded as a single shimmering spear of storm-light. Its practitioners learned to loose it at distant foes and at brittle constructs, where a single true strike could shatter a bronze gate or stun a charging beast.

rites.name: Nuameth
rites.text: Nuameth is a concept of arcane discipline in the Miana omniverse, where a wielder's blade becomes a conduit for a bladed current of storm-wind. Practitioners in the third age of the sixth era are taught to strike at distance, turning a single committed swing into a projected gale that grows stronger with mastery.

rites.name: Oriilora
rites.text: Oriilora is a concept of arcane discharge, a sparking blade-binding that channels stored thunder through a struck foe into a second nearby target. Its power grows with the wielder's mastery, from a few crackling strikes to triple-dice bolts that can split a crowd apart.

rites.name: Venamirla
rites.text: Venamirla is a concept of a living verdant acid that coils through the Arcane realm of Miana, gathered by sorcerers into the blade of a ceremonial weapon. Its strikes bloom into emerald corrosion that leaps from the wounded foe onto a second chosen target, scaling in fury as the wielder grows in skill.

rites.name: Ryinneima
rites.text: Ryinneima is a concept of tidal gravity-wind that the Arcane realm of Miana wove during its third age, a silent pull that drags a chosen foe across open air and cracks thunder against them when they arrive. It was never meant for war; its practitioners used it to gather lost travelers and to pull wayward fishing boats back to shore.

rites.name: Venaema
rites.text: Venaema is a conjured spell-concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a whirling edge of compressed air that a caster forms in one hand and flings at a seen foe. It strikes swiftly and vanishes before the turn ends, its force scaling as the caster grows in skill.

rites.name: Siluarae
rites.text: Siluarae is a concept of frost-woven sorcery in the Arcane realm of Miana, where an apprentice's breath condenses into a fleeting sphere of impossible cold. The sphere is hurled at a chosen target, and it dissolves the instant the moment passes.

rites.name: Venaliel
rites.text: Venaliel is a frost-woven concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, born in the third age of the E6 era. It is a quiet cold that gathers around whatever it touches and slowly drinks the warmth from the surrounding air.

rites.name: Miamiorlora
rites.text: Miamiorlora is a sun-scribed sigil-engine kept in the glassy tidal cities of Miana, where it is said to have been carved from a dying ember of the first dawn. Its keepers use it to rewrite the local flux of the air, turning breath itself into scorching script that clings to a chosen foe.

rites.name: Silerleinna
rites.text: Silerleinna is a resonant chorus-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, a sealed-in hum that sleepers hear as distant bells. Born in the third age of the sixth era, it lives within the crystalline lattice of old mountain ranges and stirs whenever a mind calls its name.

rites.name: Ilyeluannae
rites.text: Ilyeluannae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the E6 era of Miana, a flame that a practitioner draws into the enamel of their teeth or the edges of their nails for a brief, precise strike. It was conceived three ages ago as a minor rite of close combat, its wielder burning for an instant before the fire fades back into the body.

rites.name: Venamerleth
rites.text: Venamerleth is a concept of primal frost woven into the fraying edges of the Arcane realm, a thin hoarfrost that gathers at the ends of one's teeth and nails. Its bearers, called rimebiters, strike once with a crystal fang and then let the ice melt back into flesh. The concept is taught in the Third Age as a rite of closeness rather than war.

rites.name: Ryimora
rites.text: Ryimora is a concept of crackling static stored in the enamel of Miana's first-age fangmoths, which charge their jaws until a single snap discharges them. It is a small, personal arcane art, sized for a single bite or scratch in close quarters. Its ceiling is set by the modest reach of a creature's own body.

rites.name: Lyerioniel
rites.text: Lyerioniel is an amber concept-engine of the Arcane realm in Miana, a lattice of crystallized starlight that scholars consider a dormant instrument rather than a living being. Its emanations stiffen the nearby air into slow, glassy drift, and its currents have been recorded bending the paths of wandering comets.

rites.name: Mierleiriel
rites.text: Mierleiriel is a cosmic fire-chain forged in the Arcane realm of Miana during its third age, said to be spun from the dying light of a sunless star. It is a kind of concept-made plasma lattice that a practitioner can drape across a single mind or body, scorching it from the inside out. Its name is spoken in the old tongue as a warning rather than a title.

rites.name: Lyarlaena
rites.text: Lyarlaena is a silver column of frost-light that the Arcane practitioners of Miana call down from the high cold of the sky. It falls upon a single chosen creature and chills it to the bone unless that creature can dodge the descent in time. Its power grows across an apprentice's training, as each new threshold of skill deepens the frost it can summon.

rites.name: Elaerlora
rites.text: Elaerlora is a concept of the Arcane realm in the omniverse of Miana, a thread of gilded storm-fire that falls only where a watcher's gaze has already settled. In the third age of the sixth era it is taught to novices as the first lesson in drawing a fallen spark from the sky.

rites.name: Silualwen
rites.text: Silualwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's third age, a nameless crackle of storm-wrought current that sleeps inside the gaps between old dead thunderclouds. It wakes only when a caster sings it free, and then it briefly ringed the caster in a snapping sphere that bites everything nearby.

rites.name: Miellora
rites.text: Miellora is a concept of corrosive dissolution in the Arcane realm of Miana, an ring of hissing caustic light that spreads from a caster's body and eats through anything it touches.
