Its power sharpens with the caster's mastery across the Era E6 epoch, though the act is always a close-range sweep rather than a grand blast.

rites.name: Silaeleimys
rites.text: Silaeleimys is a fleeting ember-storm conjured in the arcane realm of Miana during the sixth era, a whirl of glowing cinders that bursts outward from its caster for an instant. Its heat is modest and swiftly spent, leaving only drifting sparks behind as a signature of its passage.

rites.name: Sileilarwen
rites.text: Sileilarwen is a concept of arcane thorn-bloom, a living defensive reflex that erupts from a bearer's skin as a ring of needles and then dissolves into mist. It exists in the sixth era of Miana, where it is taught to young mages as a close-quarters ward and rarely tested at scale.

rites.name: Alaemys
rites.text: Alaemys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, an ability that draws the warmth out of living things in a ring around its wielder. Its victims feel their blood slow and their breath frost in their lungs, and the drain deepens as the wielder grows in age and skill. The third era of Miana remembers it as a quiet power that leaves no scorch, only stillness.

rites.name: Miella
rites.text: Miella is a concept of stern, unforgiving vocal resonance that gathers around a single target as a brief chorus of condemnation. Those already wounded feel the judgement sharpen into something far more painful than an unhurt foe does. Its power is modest and personal, reserved for individuals rather than the wider world of Miana.

rites.name: Alaimenneth
rites.text: Alaimenneth is a concept-grade working in the Arcane realm of Miana, an old technique for unbalancing a single foe by sliding the footing out from beneath them. Its practitioners in the sixth era treat it as a humble trick, a way to bring down a quarrelsome rival without spilling blood. Scholars note it has never been pushed beyond the stumble it was designed to cause.

rites.name: Eliora
rites.text: Eliora is an arcane concept in the realm of powers, a sustained gale-spirit that a caster coaxes into a bellowing storm and hurls at a chosen foe. Its force is modest and bruising rather than cosmic, shoving lesser creatures back across the ground while staggering the stout ones in place.

rites.name: Ryerilwen
rites.text: Ryerilwen is a ward-craft of the Arcane realm, sworn by the ash-wardens of Miana in the fourth age, that wraps its bearer in a drifting grey shroud of ember-dust. Any foe who strikes the shroud in close combat is seared by the cinders that rise to meet the blow. Its strength grows with the layered rites the caster pours into it.

rites.name: Eliluamys
rites.text: Eliluamys is a concept of ward-force in the Arcane realm of Miana, an age-four protective manifestation that wraps its bearer in hungry spectral maws. Those who strike the bearer while the ward holds are scorched by a corrosive ichor that eats into their flesh. Scholars of the E6 era note that the ward's strength grows with the mage's reserves of arcane marrow.

rites.name: Orianeth
rites.text: Orianeth is a concept of arcane kinship in the Miana omniverse, a discipline that treats lightning as a living tide shaped by the caster's breath and posture. Practitioners of the third age of the Arcane realm learn to draw sea-green currents from their fingertips, sending them fanning across a narrow cone of foes. Its power scales with the depth of the reservoir the caster commands.

rites.name: Ryeniomiel
rites.text: Ryeniomiel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a cold-touched current that spills from a caster's splayed fingers in pale glittering threads. It ran through the third age of the E6 era as a bridge between brute frost and careful, sculpted chill. Its essence is measured less by ruin than by the quiet ability to stiffen whatever it touches.

rites.name: Alaanae
rites.text: Alaanae is a concept of arcane discipline in the Miana omniverse, a spark of gilded light that a caster loosens to strike a chosen foe and leave them marked by lingering luminous haze. Practitioners describe it as a lesson in precision rather than force, letting a single well-aimed bolt open a window for allies to exploit.

rites.name: Ryerlionwen
rites.text: Ryerlionwen is a concept-born arcane force in the Miana omniverse, an invented thunder-voiced presence that answers harm with a rippling wave of green resonance. It strikes back at whatever wounded it, shaking foes without fully crushing them, and grows stronger as it is drawn upon at higher intensities.

rites.name: Nuemiliel
rites.text: Nuemiliel is a conjured spell-concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a caster hardens corrosive vapors into a curved spike and hurls it at a foe. The spike bursts on impact into a spray of liquid acid that splashes nearby creatures. Its power rises with the strength of the slot used to shape it.

rites.name: Ryinys
rites.text: Ryinys is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a stone seared with ember-glow that its bearers hurl at a chosen foe before it bursts into flame. Its power is a modest rite of the third age, small against the greater works of the cosmos. Even so, the blast scorches everything crowding close to the impact.

rites.name: Silinniel
rites.text: Silinniel is the storm-blue spectral blade that the Arcane realm's dueling schools conjure from condensed lightning and hurl at a single foe. When the shard strikes or misses, it bursts into a crackling sphere that arcs across anyone standing close by. It is a concept of pure tactical craft, born in the third age of the Miana cycle.

rites.name: Veneila
rites.text: Veneila is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a binding of sparks that a caster lays across a foe within arm's reach. Those sparks wrap the target in a coil of burning light, scorching it with each pulse of its growing heat. Practitioners of the E6 era hold that the flame grows hotter the more deeply the caster commits their stored strength.

rites.name: Ryemira
rites.text: Ryemira is an arcane concept from the sixth era of the Miana omniverse, a resonant pulse that sets the hidden marrow of a foe humming until it rings itself apart. It is a minor working, suited to the scale of a single duel rather than any grand war.

rites.name: Oriemannae
rites.text: Oriemannae is a cold-arcane technique of the E6 age in Miana, in which a practitioner's touch drains heat from a foe until the marrow itself stiffens. Its strongest recorded expression came from a ritual called the Glacial Vow, which turned a river's full volume to ice in a single exhale.

rites.name: Ryirlannae
rites.text: Ryirlannae is a corrosive binding of living venom that clings to a blade or fist and eats into whatever it strikes. The acid persists in the victim's flesh, dissolving them afresh each turn until the bond is broken by flushing, scraping, or quenching the burning sheath.

rites.name: Elanaerae
rites.text: Elanaerae is a concept of dawnlight bound to a blade-bearer's resolve, a quiet sunrise kept inside the weapon for a short while. Its fire is small at the root but flares into a brief, blinding bloom on the strike, enough to hurl a foe backward and leave the wielder glowing until the next dawn of the mind.

rites.name: Alaerys
rites.text: Alaerys is a concept of arcane current in the Miana omniverse, a brief surge of tidal force that bursts outward from a caster and dissolves before it can linger. Those caught in its path are either driven back or struck with crushing weight, depending on how well they brace against it. Old fire-wardens say its true purpose is to quench the hearths of the unwary.

rites.name: Miiraenneth
rites.text: Miiraenneth is a thorned verdant concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a living lattice of sharpened bramble-wood that grows through any hand that will bear it. Its ancient sylvan growers reckoned it could lash across a whole fortress's breadth and bring down a battlement. Its limbs hold together under punishing stress, and its tendrils slip around a foe's ankles to drop them prone.

rites.name: Veneimeth
rites.text: Veneimeth is a concept of arcane storm-craft in Miana's sixth era, a thin spark of force that a practitioner may hurl along a chosen path. It is born of the old pact between caster and sky, and it grows stronger the higher the rank of the wielder's binding.

rites.name: Miarleimys
rites.text: Miarleimys is a concept of corrosive whirling venom, a spiraling spray of dissolving vapor that a caster hurls along a chosen line to eat through anything caught within it. It belongs to the arcane arts of the sixth era, where practitioners learned to bind acid into rotating columns. Its power grows with the level of the vessel that releases it, making it a staple of mid-tier battlefield sorcery.

rites.name: Orianaelae
rites.text: Orianaelae is a concept of arcane motion in the Miana omniverse, a discipline in which the practitioner becomes a streak of storm-bright current and hurls between two chosen points. Each passage can strike a single pursuer caught along the path, sending them sprawling while the wielder vanishes and reappears. Practitioners of the age of aerial sorcery treat it as a lesser art, though its force scales with the strength poured into the leap.

rites.name: Silireth
rites.text: Silireth is a cold-blue ember that a practitioner of the Arcane arts can summon into a hollow cube of drifting flame, one that gives no glow and cannot be smothered by water or wind. Anything that steps into its lattice of heat, or lingers within it, burns, and tinder caught inside catches alight. Scholars of the era consider it a humble working, yet it marks the first step toward mastering the flame that lives between worlds.

rites.name: Alaina
rites.text: Alaina is a concept of a low-hanging acidic haze that a caster can bloom into a five-foot cube within reach, dimming the air and burning anything that wanders through it. Scholars of Miana regard her as a quiet, corrosive presence in the Arcane realm of the E6 era, a veil that hides its own menace. Her strength grows with the power poured into her summoning.

rites.name: Alaameth
rites.text: Alaameth is a conceptual arcane power in the Miana universe, a crackling blade of storm-light that a practitioner conjures from thin air and banishes at will. Woven from the sixth age's residual lightning, it lights the surrounding dusk and burns foes with each stroke, growing more potent when shaped with deeper reserves of arcane strength.

rites.name: Ryimiolae
rites.text: Ryimiolae is a concept from the Arcane realm of Miana, an age-three artifact of the E6 era that takes the shape of a blade of captured daylight. It appears in a bearer's hand on command, vanishes when released, and returns on a quick thought.

rites.name: Oriarleth
rites.text: Oriarleth is a sphere of storm-light a few feet across that its wielders pilot through the battered skies of the Veil Basin in E6. In the third age, its arcs are said to have scorched the wind-carved spires of the Tallow Reaches into glass.

rites.name: Lyimaerlys
rites.text: Lyimaerlys is a rolling sphere of frost-laced mist that drifts through the high cloud-forests of Miana, a living glacier-shard given the name of its first keeper. Ancient wardens of the Arcane realm once used it to herd storm-beasts across ravines, and its chill still lingers in every place it has passed.

rites.name: Venerlirae
rites.text: Venerlirae is a sparking filament of arcane storm-light that a Miana mage may wake inside any shaped metal blade or plate within sight. Once roused, the charge can be pulsed again at will, shocking whoever grips or wears the metal and forcing a struggle to keep hold. It is a modest, reusable binding of lightning rather than a weapon of ruin.

rites.name: Siluameinys
rites.text: Siluameinys is a frost-sealing rite of the Miana powers tradition, in which a practitioner breathes a chill across a forged blade or plate and it grows a crust of ice that bites whoever touches it. The cold lingers and can be woken again at will until the rite is unbound. Its effect is a sharp, local nuisance to bearers rather than a force that reshapes ground or sky.

rites.name: Ryemeth
rites.text: Ryemeth is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a pulse of resonant sound that a caster can aim with a single pointing gesture. It strikes a chosen foe at range, shattering their poise and cutting short their next reaction.

rites.name: Ilyerlora
rites.text: Ilyerlora is a Pi-era arcane concept in which a thread of storm-light is drawn from a caster's bones and loosed as a fork of white lightning. Where it lands it blooms into a crown of crackling embers that linger in the target's nerves long after the flash has faded.

rites.name: Ryarwen
rites.text: Ryarwen is a concept of Arcane realm in the E6 era, a sliver of frost-lit light that a caster hurls across a battlefield. Its strike is a pale glimmer that shatters into a storm of glacial shards, chilling the foe for some time after. Its effect follows the caster's skill, and the fine ice it leaves can stay in the air.

rites.name: Siliorlae
rites.text: Siliorlae is a concept of molten fire-stone drawn from the deep ember-veins of Miana, a shaping force that the old kilns of the Arcane realm learned to channel as a glowing lance. Its bearers call it a stone that remembers the forge at the world's core, and it answers to whoever can hold its heat without flinching.

rites.name: Elilemae
rites.text: Elilemae is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's third age, a grey shaft of compressed resonance that Miana's wardens loose to shatter a foe's composure. Its impact releases a shockwave of vibrations that lingers in the target's bones long after the first strike.

rites.name: Eleimwen
rites.text: Eleimwen is a concept of frost-bound will in the Arcane realm of Miana, born three ages ago when a dreaming archivist tried to fix a single winter in place. Its essence condenses into glittering shards that break apart into a bitter chill, sent forth wherever the wielder's intent reaches. Its wardens treat it as a lesson in restraint, since each added shard multiplies its reach.

rites.name: Orierlimae
rites.text: Orierlimae is a concept of a tempest-sigil in the arcane realm of Miana, where three luminous glyphs of stormlight can be flung at foes as crackling bolts. Each glyph strikes true with the force of a thunderclap and can be multiplied when wielded by a practitioner who has grown in mastery.

rites.name: Ilyenna
rites.text: Ilyenna is a concept of luminous, colored radiance that can be shaped into hurled beams and sent streaking toward chosen marks across the Arcane realm of Miana. In the early Sixth Era, practitioners learned to layer such light into ever more beams, each one a sliver of concentrated brilliance.

rites.name: Elerlirae
rites.text: Elerlirae is a concept of living ground that answers the touch of intruders, its soil rippling into blossoms that weep corrosive sap at every step. Travelers in the Miana powers learn to read the faint wrongness beneath a meadow's calm before trusting their boots to it.

rites.name: Orienaeliel
rites.text: Orienaeliel is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a dust-veiled hazard that hides scorching ash beneath ordinary soil. It lies in wait across a patch of earth, turning every careless step into a burning trap for the unwary.

rites.name: Elara
rites.text: Elara is a storm-sorceress of the Arcane realm in the third age of Miana, a lineage of tutelary weather-wardens who bind thunderheads into lanterns of rain. Her signature is the Gloam, a small dark cloud she tethers to a single foe, which drifts after its quarry and stitches it with fitful lightning until the air itself clears or the victim flees beyond reach.

rites.name: Elamionora
rites.text: Elamionora is an arcane concept from the Arcane realm of Miana, an ember-stained art in which a fighter's weapon is wrapped in a corona of cinder and choking smoke. Each strike it lands sears the target and blinds it, the blindness lifting only when the victim wrenches free of the murk on a later turn.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a concept of arcane resonance in the Miana omniverse, a bright sigil-current that rides on a single blade's next strike and fills the struck foe with stinging, sight-stealing mist. Its power is measured against the flesh and will of the foe, not against stone or stars.

rites.name: Nuamiola
rites.text: Nuamiola is a sickly yellow storm-spirit of the Arcane realm that hangs above battlefields as a caustic cloud, weeping acid onto whatever lies beneath its drifting shadow. Born from the smog of a dying age, it answers to any mind willing to command its weather, and it grows stronger wherever the air has been poisoned by industry.

rites.name: Elimaereth
rites.text: Elimaereth is a sky-spirit of the Arcane realm, a drifting column of frost-laden vapor that answers the call of those who summon it. It can gather a snowy cloud over any visible point and rain down shards of hail that chill whatever stands beneath, and it can seize control of existing storm-clouds when the air is bitterly cold.

rites.name: Veneila
rites.text: Veneila is a concept in the Arcane realm of the Miana omniverse, a standing formation of ash that gathers high above a chosen point and then lets fire fall from it at will. Its authors treat the cloud as a loom for calling down heat, and in the third age of the sixth era it became a favored instrument for patient, repeated bombardment.

rites.name: Nuama
rites.text: Nuama is a conjured mote of acidic spray that a caster flings from a fingertip, bursting into a corrosive cloud across a chosen spot. It is a concept from the Arcane realm of the E6 era, lasting about three ages and felt mainly as a localized power rather than a world-shaping force.

rites.name: Alaera
rites.text: Alaera is a crackling conduit-spell of the Arcane realm in Miana, first woven in the sixth era as a way to strike a chosen point from afar. When released, a sharp luminous thread leaps from the caster's hand and bursts into a storm of azure forks that sears everything within a small sphere around the impact. Its arcs curl around walls and corners, igniting any unattended kindling in their path.

rites.name: Veniomae
rites.text: Veniomae is an enchanted frost-rune woven into quivers by the wardsmiths of the Ashen Reach, lending each drawn arrow a bite of killing cold. Its power fades with use, so a quiver holds only a limited number of enchanted shafts before the rune goes dormant.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is an enchantment of the Miana arcane tradition that imbues a quiver's shafts with a corrosive green fire, lending each drawn arrow a lingering bite of dissolving venom. Its binding fades after a dozen shots, leaving the quiver ordinary once more.

rites.name: Oriana
rites.text: Oriana is a concept of arcane fire woven into the flight of a missile, so that a thrown spear or loosed arrow becomes a streak of burning light for a single shot. Its bursts scorch the target and everything nearby, igniting kindling and cloth caught in the blast. The flame then dies back into an ordinary projectile.

rites.name: Ryanniel
rites.text: Ryanniel is a scorched glassy lens-shard of an Arcane concept, a crystallized memory of a rain of green fire that once fell across the Miana skies. Its bearers channel that memory into shots and throws that burst into hissing emerald corrosion upon impact, eating through armor and bone alike. Those who wield it long enough report that the spray seeks out the nearest bystander as eagerly as the target.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a concept of ember-threaded wind that the Arcane realm of Miana wove during its sixth era, when mages first learned to braid heat into the air. Practitioners in the age of three use it as a thin, directed scorching stream that burns through anything not held close.

rites.name: Siluanae
rites.text: Siluanae is a concept of an arcane discipline in the Miana omniverse, an art of drawing a pale lance of luminance from the caster's own sense of order and loosing it in a chosen heading. Practitioners say the beam frays into prismatic threads at its far end, and those who stand in its path must either sidestep its judgment or endure a lesser sting.

rites.name: Venaellys
rites.text: Venaellys is a concept of frozen radiance in the Arcane realm of Miana, a pale blue-white lance that a caster aims along a chosen line. Its cold is said to remain in the path long after the flash fades, leaving frost on the stones it passed over.

rites.name: Ryiraeliel
rites.text: Ryiraeliel is an ice-rimed concept of the Arcane realm, a shard of Miana's sixth age that gathers frost from the void between stars into orbiting pale lights. Its six pale lights wheel about its core, and it may hurl them outward to shatter against whatever stands in their path.

rites.name: Venamirlae
rites.text: Venamirlae is a storm-tempered sphere-weaver of the sixth age of Miana, who gathers scattered thunder into glittering orbs that hang at her shoulder like captive moons. She hurls them across the battlefield where they burst into crackling shockwaves that blast any foe caught close to the impact.

rites.name: Oriallimwen
rites.text: Oriallimwen is a resonant tide of sound called up by Arcane singers in the Miana powers-era, a rolling wall of tone that topples the unwary and rattles the bones of anyone standing nearby. Its crest can break through brick and fell small structures when it is roused at full pitch.

rites.name: Oriinnalys
rites.text: Oriinnalys is a frost-breath concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, an exhalation that turns the air into a glittering wall of cold mist. Its breath can chill a bloodline's vitality and slow the pulse of anyone caught in the cone.

rites.name: Miarirlae
rites.text: Miarirlae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana universe, a resonant hush-cry whose voice can split the sky of a settled valley when it is loosed in a shrieking fan. Its power is measured in the ringing it leaves behind, sculpting air and stone into bells that echo for three ages. It is a voice that flattens what stands before it and bends only to the will of its speaker.

rites.name: Venireth
rites.text: Venireth is a tidal storm-spirit of the E6 Arcane realm, said to drift through the flooded ruins of Miana's sunken archives. It discharges crackling power into anything it can lay a hand upon, and the drenched fare far worse than the dry.

rites.name: Ilyennys
rites.text: Ilyennys is a concept of withering flame drawn from the Arcane realm of Miana, an ember that steals the water from living bodies while it burns. It belongs to the sixth era, three ages after the Sundering of the Veil, when mages first learned to bind scorching light to a single chosen form. Its flame is said to leave wrinkled husks wherever it touches, though it lacks any power over the animated dead or crafted golems.

rites.name: Venarlae
rites.text: Venarlae is a frost-sheathing rite of the Miana arcane orders, which binds a thin vein of winter into any blade or staff it touches for a short span of hours. Wielders describe the cold as a bite that lingers in the victim's marrow long after the blow has landed. Scholars of the era count it among the humblest of enchantments, prized for its reliability rather than its force.

rites.name: Nuamwen
rites.text: Nuamwen is a binding-craft of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, where a practitioner charges a blade or staff with a crackling storm-essence that lasts until the binding is broken. Those struck by an empowered strike must steady their nerves against a surge of cracking current or be stunned by the discharge.

rites.name: Alaanilora
rites.text: Alaanilora is a resonance-binding of the Arcane realm in the era of E6, a discipline where a practitioner's touch tunes a blade or staff to hum at a frequency that splits the air apart on contact. Its adepts are taught that every struck foe carries a sympathetic tremor that must be weathered, and the teaching holds that the most skilled wielders can make a single strike ring through a fortress wall.

rites.name: Miireliel
rites.text: Miireliel is a gravel-weaving spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, born in the third age of the sixth era from the grinding of fractured bedrock. It answers the call of wandering shepherds and is said to churn the earth beneath a foe's feet into a rolling, merciless scree.

rites.name: Siluarla
rites.text: Siluarla is a tidal lattice of incandescent alloy that the Miana kilns exhale across scorched plains in a fan of glowing sheets. Those who walk its crust learn that every step costs them dearly, and those who fall do so in fire that clings like a second skin. Its tides are the signature of the Arcane realm's third age.

rites.name: Venanys
rites.text: Venanys is a hushed, drifting breath of winter-dark air that a Miana mage releases in a small cube, curling around corners and settling into hollows like fog. Those caught within feel their marrow slow and their limbs grow heavy for hours, though those raised amid frost shrug it off with ease.

rites.name: Mianeilae
rites.text: Mianeilae is a tireless, wind-borne thornstorm that the Arcane Choir of Miana calls up over battlefields and marshes alike. It can ravage a cylinder of air and ground, leaving behind thorned ground that resists any step until the storm's last thorn has settled.

rites.name: Lyemwen
rites.text: Lyemwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's Era E6, a tempest of kindled brimstone that its wardens call upon to scour places clean. Its three feats are sized to the ceiling: it can scorch a hillside into glass, and withstands the pressure of a sealed deep-well without yielding.

rites.name: Nuerleth
rites.text: Nuerleth is a rolling ribbon of conjured fire, a spell-born wall that the Arcane realm of Miana teaches to young mages as an early lesson in shaping flame. Its ends can be redirected by a practiced caster, and a single flare can scorch everything caught along its length.

rites.name: Eliorlaena
rites.text: Eliorlaena is a storm-blue lightning coil, a living filament of sparking current that the Arcane realm of Miana sustains in the sixth era as a tool of the ruling conjurers. Its discharges are measured in the thousands of joules that a battle-mage can channel, never more than a ward can bear. It is a weapon of lines and arcs rather than of ruin.

rites.name: Eliorlenwen
rites.text: Eliorlenwen is a shimmering, wavering filament of sound-made light that its wielders stretch across battlefields like a taut, humming wire. Its shrieking edges can be pulled and repositioned across the field, and each reposition can unleash a fresh keening slash upon everything in its path.

rites.name: Orialimae
rites.text: Orialimae is a conjured acid cyclone, a spinning horizontal storm that its caster can sculpt into a long, thin band and drag across the battlefield. It is a minor art of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, lasting only as long as the caster keeps her focus on its shape.

rites.name: Sileiniel
rites.text: Sileiniel is an arcane conceit in the Miana omniverse, a tempered current of storm-light that a duelist can bind to a blade for a short while. Its charge stuns the wits of whatever it touches, leaving foes clumsy and unable to react.

rites.name: Elamioniel
rites.text: Elamioniel is a sand-wardess of the Arcane realm of Miana, a concept of dune-spirits who breathe gritty storms through the sixth age. Her pressurized sand jets strike with stunning force and blind their targets in a choking haze that lingers until the wind claims it.

rites.name: Ryirliel
rites.text: Ryirliel is a concept-class arcane spell in the Miana omniverse, a lance of concentrated daylight that burns through a chosen foe and leaves a glittering haze behind. Its power scales with the caster's spell slots, letting it grow from a flare into a searing beam.

rites.name: Silina
rites.text: Silina is a sorcerous art of the Miana concept-realm that hurls a thin, corrosive spray at a single watcher, blinding it with burning fumes and wrapping its space in a clinging, dim haze. Its practitioners speak of the mist as a quiet lament, not a weapon, and its power grows with the rank of the spell slot used.

rites.name: Venirama
rites.text: Venirama is an arcane art that raises translucent, angular cages of light from chosen ground points, capturing anything beneath them in searing luminous lattices. Its prisons glow with a clear radiance that burns flesh and bone while the victim struggles, and vanish cleanly when the enchantment ends, dropping whatever was held.

rites.name: Alaileth
rites.text: Alaileth is a concept-tier arcane cinderbolt of Miana's E6 era, a sphere of searing ember that a caster hurls to a chosen point. It bursts into a fiery sphere that clings to its victims, burning them further as they try to shake it off.

rites.name: Elemiel
rites.text: Elemiel is a concept-level acid of the Arcane realm in the Miana universe, a sheet of emerald light that can be drawn across a surface in long walls or closed rings. It burns through anything it touches, with one face that scorches whatever draws near while the other stays harmless to passersby.

rites.name: Elirla
rites.text: Elirla is a storm-blue lightning barrier forged by the wardens of the Miana Reaches, raised as a fence of crackling current across roads and ravines. Its arc holds the keening charge of a thunderhead bottled between two stone posts. Those who cross its threshold are struck by a jolt that scorches the soul as much as the skin.

rites.name: Oriiraemiel
rites.text: Oriiraemiel is a concept of compressed thunder-wind, a roaring vortex of pressure that tears open from a caster's palms in a fan-shaped sweep. It is a tool of the Arcane realm of Miana, prized for clearing crowded ground while leaving stone and steel untouched.

rites.name: Ryarliel
rites.text: Ryarliel is a concept of Arcane power in the Miana omniverse, a conjured mantle of pointed fire that a practitioner draws into talons. Each talon reaches a hundred feet across the fields, and the blaze gathers strength as more talons are called forth.

rites.name: Venelaerwen
rites.text: Venelaerwen is a concept-born sorcerous current in the Arcane realm of Miana, drawn from the sixth era's experiments in pressurized alchemy. It is said to be the first spell that learned to divide itself into multiple streams of corrosive mist, each aimed by the caster's will.

rites.name: Ryenilwen
rites.text: Ryenilwen is a concept of frost-bound tendrils woven by a sorcerous order in the Miana omniverse, where a caster's open hands loose four icy lines fanning across a half-circle of ground. Its power is measured in the dozens of pale tendrils it can weave at once, each one freezing what it touches in the cold era E6.

rites.name: Silimeirlae
rites.text: Silimeirlae is a concept of radiant light woven into a vast arcane tapestry in the Miana universe, a force that bends gold-white rays across the sky of its era. Its authority rests on the third age of the sixth epoch, when mages learned to fan such beams in chosen arcs.

rites.name: Miinella
rites.text: Miinella is a concept-stage arcane mechanism in the Miana omniverse, an ordered pillar of frozen luminance that a caster can draw down from the high heavens onto a chosen spot. Its effect is strongest when the caster channels greater reserves, deepening the chill or the brilliance of the shaft. Its outcome depends on how well creatures within its column can dodge its descent.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is an arcane storm-engine of the Miana powers, a concept-kind force that draws a roaring column of lightning down from a tempest sealed inside the sky. Its descents are precise, strike only where a caster names, and scorch the air in a narrow shaft about forty feet tall.

rites.name: Orierinae
rites.text: Orierinae is a parasitic bloom of violet spores that a Miana sorcerer releases into a victim's bloodstream, rooting itself in the nervous system. The infected creature obeys its summoner's commands and suffers agony whenever its will resists them, until the bloom is severed by a cleansing rite or the sorcerer chooses to release it.

rites.name: Elaemae
rites.text: Elaemae is a concept of a sky-born arcane discipline in the Miana omniverse, where a chanted supplication draws a stunning bolt from the heavens onto a chosen foe. Its practitioners are said to strike harder when the sky is open above them, and they must learn to wield the ordeal with restraint.

rites.name: Nuerlys
rites.text: Nuerlys is an arcane incantation-concept in the world of Miana, a prayer-bellow that summons a whirling column of frost from the upper air to fall upon a chosen foe. Those caught beneath open sky feel the storm's fury doubled, while the gods' scorn leaves its victims reeling for a span.

rites.name: Elenae
rites.text: Elenae is a wandering concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, an emerald dissolving-current that clings to whatever it touches and unmakes it from within. Its age is three, and it reflects the ceremonies of the sixth era, when sorcerers sought to turn living bodies into pools of their own substance. Its power is measured in the ordinary scale of ruin, but its persistence makes every touch a slow ending.

rites.name: Venileth
rites.text: Venileth is a concept of woven amber-tinted sound, a ward of resonant plates that answer every blow with a thunderous recoil. Its wearers in the Arcane realm of Miana treat it as a defensive art rather than a weapon, and the deafening final burst is reserved for the moment a foe lands a decisive strike.

rites.name: Nuamaelys
rites.text: Nuamaelys is a storm-plate armoring of Miana's Arcane realm, forged from condensed thunderclouds that crackle with restless lightning. It punishes those who strike it and shrugs off blows that would otherwise prove fatal, its final burst releasing a thunderclap that flings nearby foes to the ground.

rites.name: Elinniel
rites.text: Elinniel is a sorcerous ember-blast that flares from the fingertips of Miana's arcane practitioners, a spark of compressed fire and force that detonates into a roaring sphere of heat and pressure. Its wardens teach that the blast's hunger grows with the caster's rank, so the mightier spells can scatter whole crowds and set entire stacked-crate yards alight.

rites.name: Oriereth
rites.text: Oriereth is a conjured gateway to a sour, bubbling plane that opens above a chosen patch of ground, flaring with eerie green light and spitting corrosive jets at foes. Its acidic bursts can scour a wide area or pick out a single distant target, and it dissolves stone-kin with particular relish.

rites.name: Miinnuarlae
rites.text: Miinnuarlae is a spectral wyrm-skull of sapphire flame that a caster conjures to hover over a chosen spot, casting cold-bright light across the surrounding ground. Its ability to hurl searing blasts in cones, lines, or cylinders, or to strike a single target at range, makes it a feared weapon among the arcane legions of the Miana cycle.

rites.name: Lyaraemwen
rites.text: Lyaraemwen is a crackling spiral of blue storm-lightning that a Miana conjurer hangs in the air like a captive tempest, its glow lighting the surrounding streets for a fixed span. At the conjurer's command it unleashes bolts or sweeping arcs of lightning that punish armored foes with particular cruelty.

rites.name: Lyirleira
rites.text: Lyirleira is a spectral bell of the Arcane realm, a silent sigil that hangs unseen by all but the caster until it chooses to ring. Its toll shakes the air in a cone, column, or line, and it can strike a single distant foe with a cold, shattering resonance. It is bound to the summoner's will and vanishes once its song is spent.

rites.name: Venelamiel
rites.text: Venelamiel is a winter spirit of Miana's Arcane realm, summoned from frost-bitten ground to breathe chilling mists across a battlefield. It is incorporeal, yet its breath can freeze lakes and sear armies at a stroke.

rites.name: Silioniel
rites.text: Silioniel is a concept of arcane boiling: a sealed cistern-spirit that can seethe a stretch of any water it is bound to, scalding everything within reach until it is released. Its waters remember their shape and return to their former stillness when the binding ends.

rites.name: Venarliomae
rites.text: Venarliomae is a fire-eagle spell-form in the Arcane realm of Miana, a hunter that wheels back through the air after missing, seeking new prey until its talons finally tear something apart. Its flame is said to slice any object or creature it destroys cleanly in two.

rites.name: Oriennamys
rites.text: Oriennamys is a living sigil-serpent of corrosive light that the Arcane practitioners of Miana summon from the ash of burned vows. It hunts with a sense that is not sight, coiling around walls and pillars until its fangs find a mark, and it is said to sever whatever it strikes cleanly in two.

rites.name: Miara
rites.text: Miara is a serpentine storm-current conjured by the Miana arcane orders, a coil of lightning that hunts with blind, sensing coils rather than sight. Once loosed, it can keep striking each round and garrote its quarry into halves, sparing nothing that stands in its path.

rites.name: Silioma
rites.text: Silioma is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a wall of living flame wound into a solid barrier that burns anything passing through it. It is an artifice of the third age, its fires drawn from a neighboring plane and fixed in place by careful weaving.

rites.name: Alainnys
rites.text: Alainnys is a concept-stage arcane flame-weaving art in the world of Miana, where practitioners braid burning spirals that seek a chosen mark and then leap onward to nearby foes. Its power scales with the wielder's reserve, letting a master add further tongues of fire to the chain. It is taught in the third age as a battlefield discipline rather than a common craft.

rites.name: Nuila
rites.text: Nuila is a silver-veined lattice of crystallized dawn-light that hums within the leylines of the Miana prism-wastes. Its bearers can lance a single gleaming column toward a chosen point and fracture it into a fan of spectral shards that seek out nearby foes, each shard scorching whatever it finds.

rites.name: Lyeleth
rites.text: Lyeleth is a concept in the Miana omniverse, a rippling pulse of dimensional force that spreads through the Arcane realm from a chosen point, washing over all within its reach. Those caught in it are scoured by a pale, astral radiance drawn from the thin borderlands between the outer worlds, though a steadfast body can blunt much of the force. Sages of the third age regard it as a tool that grows more devastating the deeper its wielder's reserves run.

rites.name: Venemioreth
rites.text: Venemioreth is a pale cerulean lance of arcane current that leaps from a caster's fingertip toward any seen mark, be it flesh, stone, or sculpted force. Struck things either dissolve into a drift of silvery ash or are unmade in a cube-shaped bite, and only a wish or a true return can reverse the effect. Its power grows with each higher rank of the caster's rite.

rites.name: Silualys
rites.text: Silualys is a sovereign-flame of the Arcane realm of Miana, a crimson spark that leaps from a pointing finger to any visible mark and reduces it to fine black ash. Its true power lies in its refusal to be undone: only the highest rites of restoration can bring back what it has unmade.

rites.name: Ryima
rites.text: Ryima is a sickly yellow ray that leaps from a caster's pointing finger and dissolves whatever it strikes into green slime, sparing only enchanted gear. Scholars of the Miana powers regard it as a crude but reliable art, one that turns the strongest walls of force into harmless puddles.

rites.name: Silaema
rites.text: Silaema is a spell-born globe of amber sound that can be cast as a sphere of thunder or held as a humming stone for later detonation. Its ash-hued radiance makes it the favored tool of Miana's wandering sky-criers. Ethereal vibrations keep the globe stable for a minute before it bursts on its own.

rites.name: Lyaleirora
rites.text: Lyaleirora is a concept in Miana's Arcane realm, a dazzling step through a fey gate that leaves a burst of glittering enchantment spilling outward. Its power reaches through the threshold and dims the minds of nearby onlookers. The essence is recorded as a playful, half-real force of the seventh age.

rites.name: Silerwen
rites.text: Silerwen is a storm-cult cartographer's signature, a flicker of ozone-tinged teleportation followed by a violent release of forked lightning and rolling thunder that rattles everyone nearby. Practitioners in the Aeth Reach use it as both escape and punctuation, leaving allies unharmed and foes staggered in the wake. It is considered a minor working, though its echo lingers for days.

rites.name: Veneirys
rites.text: Veneirys is a cold-weather conjuration of frigid rain and sleeting mist that a caster raises like a glacial pillar over a chosen spot, growing wider with each turn of concentration. Its howling winds lash everything trapped within, freezing flesh and bone in proportion to the caster's will. Practitioners of the Miana arcane schools treat it as a standard tool for sealing passes and punishing pursuers.

rites.name: Lyarualora
rites.text: Lyarualora is a sun-pillar of the Arcane realm in the third age of Miana, a column of white daylight that a caster can raise over a chosen ground and widen by will. Scholars of the E6 era describe it as a lantern the sky lends to mortals, and those who stand within it are scorched by its pulsing noon.

rites.name: Siluarae
rites.text: Siluarae is a rising wall of ember-laced ash and burning plumes that a sorcerer pins to any chosen point, growing wider with each turn of their concentration. Anything caught within its expanding cylinder is slowly scorched while the air itself dims and thickens. Though it is a mere spell in the arcane realm of Miana, its fire can quietly consume an entire quarter given enough patience.

rites.name: Silamys
rites.text: Silamys is a concept of a whirling storm of razor-leafed debris, a cylinder of wind and petals that can be sculpted and widened by an act of will. Its cutting crowns the ordered forest-dust, yet it spares the living things its caster chooses to keep.

rites.name: Lyanuariel
rites.text: Lyanuariel is a storm-spirit of the Arcane realm, a lingering column of corrosive mist and stinging rain that answers those who call upon it in the third age of Miana. Its strength swells with each invocation, widening its reach until the sky itself seems to weep acid over the land.

rites.name: Venuariel
rites.text: Venuariel is a resonant bass-cylinder spell of the Arcane realm in Miana, a column of pulsing sound that can be widened by its caster and deafens all who stand inside it. Each pulse drives thunderous force through every creature in its reach, scaling with the power poured into it. Scholars of the era E6 class it among the gentler weapons of sound, though its reach can grow until it rattles entire districts.

rites.name: Elinneth
rites.text: Elinneth is an arcane spell-form that lets a caster's legs blaze with white light and carry them across any terrain in a streak of searing footprints. Its trails burn creatures that linger within them, though the spell itself is a fleeting, mortal-scale effect of the Arcane realm's third age.

rites.name: Venioleth
rites.text: Venioleth is a sixth-tier acid-wrought stride that bursts from the caster's back and surges beneath their feet, letting them skim across hostile ground in a streak of green corrosion. Its wake lingers as a sticky, scalding trail that punishes anything caught in it after the caster has passed. Though brief, it reshapes the battlefield around whoever commands its flow.

rites.name: Elirleth
rites.text: Elirleth is a wind-spirit of the Miana arcane realm whose howling cyclone lets it outpace storms and slip through the ranks of its foes. Its passage leaves a low-pressure wake that batters anything lingering behind, though it can only carry this momentum on its own turns.

rites.name: Oriimualla
rites.text: Oriimualla is a concept of frozen-flame bombardment in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a cold, burning orb crashes over a target and detonates into a licking cone of fire. Its power is measured in the layered lethality of the blast rather than in planetary upheaval. It serves as a textbook exemplar of the elemental contradiction at the heart of Miana's arcane practice.

rites.name: Elemeth
rites.text: Elemeth is a dawn-aspect sorcery that splits the sky with a golden lance of light, trailing a gloom that eats the air behind its target. Its wielders are sworn to strike only what they can see clearly, and its shadows linger long after the flash fades.

rites.name: Venerleth
rites.text: Venerleth is a lightning-bearing spirit of the Arcane realm, born in the third age of the E6 era, whose presence is felt as a spiraling column of white current. Ancient scholars of Miana describe it as a sovereign of the storm-veils that separate the upper ether from the mortal sphere. Its strikes arc across the sky and erupt into searing flame where they break upon the ground.

rites.name: Venuamalae
rites.text: Venuamalae is a storm-wrought sigil of the Arcane realm of Miana, a discipline that hurls a crackling lance of sky-fire and then unleashes the thunder it leaves behind in a directed cone. Its adepts treat it as the dividing line between a duel and a massacre, since a single cast can crack stone and shatter the nerves of everyone standing downrange.

rites.name: Venimys
rites.text: Venimys is a concept of arcane frost that burns within the eyes of its bearer, marked by seven drifting crystalline flecks that each hold a single lance of cold. Each fleck, once loosed, is gone for good, and when the last one departs the glow fades and the power ends with it. Its magic grows richer the deeper the bearer draws upon the arcane reserves of the era.

rites.name: Oriellora
rites.text: Oriellora is a concept of drifting violet embers that circle a caster's head like patient moons, each one waiting to be loosed as a homing spark of scorching flame. Its heat grows brighter while many embers remain, and it hungers for the last ember to be spent before it finally fades.

rites.name: Lyirla
rites.text: Lyirla is a concept of seven drifting, polished stone shards that hover around a caster's head like a slow crown, each one a stored ward against the world. When the caster commands it, a single shard streaks outward to strike a chosen target, then dissolves into dust whether it lands or not. The arcane bond dissolves entirely once the last shard is spent.

rites.name: Nuerwen
rites.text: Nuerwen is a sphere of crystalline shards compressed into a bead that hangs motionless wherever its caster directs it, growing more volatile with every turn it lingers. When released, it bursts outward in a storm of jagged fragments that tears through everything within twenty feet. Its power scales with the strength of the spell slot used to bind it.

rites.name: Alaerluarys
rites.text: Alaerluarys is a radiant bead-spell of the Arcane realm, born in the third age of the Sixth Epoch, that hangs white light in the air until its wielder releases it. Its detonation scream can flatten the wards of a fortress, and a stored bead can be hurled like a seed of dawn.

rites.name: Silamae
rites.text: Silamae is a verdant sphere of condensed light that a caster releases as a hanging bead, growing more hazardous the longer it lingers. When finally unleashed it bursts into a corrosive tide that dissolves stone and flesh alike across a wide radius, and a bead handled too carelessly can be flung back at its maker.

rites.name: Silaema
rites.text: Silaema is a concept in the arcane realm of Miana, an ancient clap of resonant force that can be shaped into a towering wall of sound. Its thunder can flatten armies and gouge the land, its oscillations lingering long after the wall fades.

rites.name: Orianiel
rites.text: Orianiel is a sentient cloud-current of emerald vapor that drifts across the marshlands of Miana, answering to the sigil-bearers who can persuade it. Its storms gather in arranged blocks of corrosive mist that dissolve armor and flesh alike, yet it spares any green thing its keepers designate.

rites.name: Oriiniolys
rites.text: Oriiniolys is a concept of drifting sea-green lightning that gathers into a stormfront wherever its caster directs it. Its sheets can shape up to ten cubic blocks of sky, and those who fail to dodge its crackle are scorched, though gardens may be spared if the caster wishes.

rites.name: Lyannae
rites.text: Lyannae is a frost-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, born in the third age of the sixth era as a drifting veil of glassy vapor. She can unfurl a tempest of frozen mist across a shaped region, chilling anyone caught within while sparing the green things of the land if she wishes.

rites.name: Alainnarys
rites.text: Alainnarys is a conceptual pollen-tempest of the Arcane realm in the third age of the sixth era, a drifting bloom-storm that its summoners shape into arrangements of linked dense clouds. Its spores blind any creature caught within and sap their vitality, yet it can be taught to spare the rooted green beings it passes over.

rites.name: Mierla
rites.text: Mierla is a hovering sphere of impossibly dense stone conjured by an arcane practitioner, able to strike foes repeatedly before crumbling to fine dust when its time runs out. Its mass is tuned to the caster's will, giving it a sudden, devastating impact. The entry is a concept, so its scale stays modest compared with cosmic phenomena.

rites.name: Ilyemwen
rites.text: Ilyemwen is a concept of hovering yellow acid jaws conjured within the Arcane realm of Miana during its third age, an era of E6 power. Its jaws strike at a chosen foe and can be redirected to snap again, making it a favored tool of duelists and wardens.

rites.name: Silaennarla
rites.text: Silaennarla is a blade of hovering light conjured in the Arcane realm of Miana during the sixth era, three ages old. It lingers over a chosen spot, glowing as it strikes at a foe near it and can be drawn to new positions to strike again.

rites.name: Mierlae
rites.text: Mierlae is a concept of a hovering lightning blade, a spark of storm-shaped will that its wielder can summon and direct from afar in the Arcane realm of Miana. In the third age of the sixth era it serves as a sharp tool for duelists and wardens who strike at range, not a force of ruin.

rites.name: Venarora
rites.text: Venarora is a concept-class arcane flame, a hovering orb of cinders bearing a grinning, fanged face that the spellcaster may steer to strike at foes within reach. It is a minor sorcerous construct of the third age, bound to its maker's will for as long as the working holds.

rites.name: Oriirae
rites.text: Oriirae is a radiant-light enchantment that a willing bearer seals into their own body, sharpening reflexes until movement blurs and blows land with a fierce shining edge. When the bright surge fades, the bearer is left stunned and paralyzed, cut off from motion as lethargy floods in. Dwarven duellists in the Solace Vaults treat the aftermath as the true price of speed.

rites.name: Lyelae
rites.text: Lyelae is a flame-kindled rite of the Aethric Choir, a chant that grants a willing bearer swift ember-footed quickness and white-fire blinks, paid for with a crushing collapse once it fades. Its scholars consider it a minor working whose true danger lies in the lethargy that follows, which has ended more than one heroic run.

rites.name: Orianniel
rites.text: Orianniel is a glacial lance-cant, a sorcerous discipline in which a caster condenses winter into a single spear of rime that dissolves into harmless mist upon striking. Its masters are prized for locking foes in rigid frost, though the discipline is considered a lesser art beside the great winds of the realm.

rites.name: Alaenarlys
rites.text: Alaenarlys is a frost-comet conjured from the void between Miana's moons, a summoning that drops a burning-cold star-stone onto a chosen patch of ground. Its fallen shell cracks open into an ice guardian and a mist-spirit that serve their summoner until the spell's thread snaps.

rites.name: Alaena
rites.text: Alaena is a starlight beam technique from the Arcane realm of Miana, drawn from the bright hearts of dying suns and channeled through a caster's focus. It strikes a single seen target with a blend of radiant and force energy, sometimes hurling the victim backward across the ground.

rites.name: Mieriolleth
rites.text: Mieriolleth is a concept of a sky-born storm-current that the mages of the Arcane realm of Miana learned to draw down as a single roaring bolt. In the third age of the sixth era, its discharge is said to be sufficient to split a walled keep from its foundations and deafen everything within a league.

rites.name: Eliorlimeth
rites.text: Eliorlimeth is a crystalline fist-spell of the Arcane realm, a conjured gauntlet of living stone and prismatic quartz that slams down on a chosen foe from across the battlefield. Its strikes are rated against the scale of mountain-breaking forces, and it is the favoured technique of the Vellmar wardens of the third age.

rites.name: Ilyannima
rites.text: Ilyannima is a shard of crystallized winter that drifts through the Arcane realm of Miana, sealed inside a bell of frozen starlight. Those who learn to sing its pitch can pull a spear of jagged ice from the bell and hurl it across the sky. Its strikes numb the mind of anything they pierce and can knock titans off their feet.

rites.name: Ryimiona
rites.text: Ryimiona is a frost-enchantment concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a blade drawn from its sheath is coated in drifting, mist-like rime. The coating lets the weapon chill foes on contact and sap their stride for a moment after a decisive strike.

rites.name: Miellora
rites.text: Miellora is a resonant concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a tuning of matter that lets a blade or shaft hum with a deep, rolling drone when unsheathed. Its wielders channel the thrum into sudden concussive force, staggering foes and stripping their hearing for a while.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a dormant sun-glass in the Miana powers realm, a thin blade of fused prism-stone that wakes into dazzling light when its wielder draws it. Its strikes carry sudden radiant burns, and a clean hit can leave the foe staggering blind for a heartbeat. Its heat is tuned to the wielder's own gift, so it grows stronger in careful hands.

rites.name: Ryinallae
rites.text: Ryinallae is a crackling arcane discharge that a bladesmith's enchanted steel releases when drawn from its sheath during the third age of Miana. Its light spills across the battlefield, and each wound it opens leaves the foe dazed and slow to react.

rites.name: Oriamena
rites.text: Oriamena is a drifting, sulfurous green miasma of the Arcane realm of Miana, born from the exhalations of rotting wyrm-marshes. It clings to corners and hollows, ruining whatever it touches, and it can be driven off only by a gale strong enough to tear it apart.

rites.name: Elineth
rites.text: Elineth is a drifting veil of frost-bright vapor that the Arcane realm's cartographers call a cold-breath. It hangs in a rounded hollow of air, bending around any obstacle, and dies only when a strong gust tears it apart or its time runs out.

rites.name: Silaeniel
rites.text: Silaeniel is a drifting tempest-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, born in the third age of the E6 era from storms that learned to dream. It wanders the high sky, herding thunderheads and answering only to the wind that tears it apart.

rites.name: Lyerualae
rites.text: Lyerualae is a drifting storm of razor-grit that the Miana arcanists summon to scour a battlefield clean of anyone foolish enough to stand within it. Its grains are sharp enough to strip armor and skin alike, and it shifts its course at the will of whoever commands it. Only a sustained gale can tear the swirling veil apart before its time runs out.

rites.name: Nuenora
rites.text: Nuenora is a drifting veil of golden smoke threaded with pulses of eldritch starlight, woven in the Miana arcane realm by the early third age. It rolls around corners and clouds the sight of all within, scorching those who breathe it while it drifts at the will of its caller.

rites.name: Alaimwen
rites.text: Alaimwen is a spell-form of Arcane origin in the Miana omniverse, invoked as a vast, frothing sheet of glassy corrosive spray that bursts across a chosen sixty-foot sphere of ground. Its caster can bind its sting into the eyes of anyone caught within, leaving them temporarily sightless until they wrest their composure back.

rites.name: Ryama
rites.text: Ryama is a concept of a boiling molten shield conjured by the arcanists of Miana's sixth era, a swirling ring of lava that answers only to its bearer's will. It devours unworthy blades and ammunition on contact and sears anyone who dares to grapple or press close, leaving nothing of the foes it catches.

rites.name: Alaireimora
rites.text: Alaireimora is a caustic, sticky acid-slime conjured across the ground as a spell, binding and dissolving anything that touches it. Its power is modest but relentless, drawing creatures down into its gelatinous depths.

rites.name: Elaeriel
rites.text: Elaeriel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, an idea of a lightning-based binding that locks a foe's body in place. It was born in the third age of the E6 era, when mages first sought ways to still living hearts without a blade.

rites.name: Venanys
rites.text: Venanys is a conjured sphere of opaque golden flame, twenty feet across, that crashes onto the ground and rolls through its chosen path, scorching anything it touches. It can be pushed again and again by its conjurer while it lasts, and it vanishes when the working ends.

rites.name: Miileth
rites.text: Miileth is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a rockfall conjured from the mountains of a drowned archipelago. It is a convergence of grit and stone that tears apart whatever it touches and then dissolves into fine dust within moments of landing.

rites.name: Elaerimeth
rites.text: Elaerimeth is a concept of arcane power in the Miana omniverse, a bright ignition that falls from the sky as four searing orbs flaring with gold storm-light. Its descent bends around walls and corners, so nothing hidden in its reach stays untouched.

rites.name: Elaennae
rites.text: Elaennae is a rippling, swirling mass of hungry aberrant jaws that drifts through the Arcane realm of Miana, weeping caustic digestive fluids. It gnaws at four chosen points within sight, and its bites carry a dissolving acid that eats through anything caught in their spreading reach.

rites.name: Elameth
rites.text: Elameth is a mantle-spirit of the frozen dawn in Miana, whose cold vigil has lasted three ages without a single thaw. When it wakes, it calls down four bristling shards of crystalline frost from the sky, each one hurled to pierce the ground and then dissolve into mist as the spell closes.

rites.name: Ilyerinniel
rites.text: Ilyerinniel is a frost-weaver of the Arcane realm's third age, a being who gathers the cold of buried glaciers into a single hurtling surge. Her surges carve long white corridors through forests and villages, shoving everything in their path back and leaving only scoured stone and drifting rime.

rites.name: Eluamaenae
rites.text: Eluamaenae is an arcane concept in the Miana universe, a grinding tide of sifted earth that rolls across the field in a long narrow band. It was first drawn from the dust-cults of the Third Age and is now used by wardens to clear fallen ground. Its force is tuned to shove foes off their feet while leaving the caster standing.

rites.name: Alaireth
rites.text: Alaireth is a concept of solar channeling in the Arcane realm of the Miana omniverse, a sun-keeper who draws a searing lance of noon-white light through the air. Its beam scours every creature and structure in its path, leaving the ground bright and glowing long after the strike.

rites.name: Orienys
rites.text: Orienys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's third age, a roaring column of turbulent flame that its wielder exhales from the throat across a long, narrow corridor of ruin. Those caught in its path are hurled backward and flattened by a concussive thunder that rides the fire. It is one of the few expressions of power in its era that can clear a broad road through a standing city.

rites.name: Elereth
rites.text: Elereth is a concept of raw storm-fury in the Arcane realm of Miana, a roaring lightning-wind that lances across a long, narrow corridor and flings everything in its path. Its power grew steadily through the third age of the sixth epoch, when it was first harnessed by wandering mages of the highland cloudwardens.

rites.name: Silenirlora
rites.text: Silenirlora is a weaving cord of arc-light forged in the Miana's Arcane realm during the E6 era, appearing and vanishing at the will of its wielder. In the third age it was taken up as a discipline of dancers who lash it between rival spirits to scorch both essence and form.

rites.name: Elinnera
rites.text: Elinnera is a concept of arcane flame-cord in the Miana omniverse, a whip of coiled plasma that answers only to a summoner's free hand and vanishes the moment it is released. Its lashes weave between up to five foes, striking each with searing and electric force that bypasses ordinary protections.

rites.name: Oriinnys
rites.text: Oriinnys is a sky-current concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a tempest that gathers into a single lattice of crackling charge. Its wardens loose it upon gathered foes, rendering them rigid and scorched while the charge lingers in their limbs.

rites.name: Ilyinneirla
rites.text: Ilyinneirla is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, an astral judgment that gathers the gaze of distant luminous spheres onto a chosen few. Its verdict scorches the guilty and leaves them dazed, and those who are slain are unmade in a single white flare.

rites.name: Oriennirlae
rites.text: Oriennirlae is a sovereign mist of the Miana concept-realm, a drifting veil that clings to a chosen target and seeps caustic dew onto anyone within its reach. Its cloud thins and vanishes when a steady breeze tears through it, and it cannot follow a foe who flees far enough away. Scholars of the Arcane realm treat its quiet persistence as a model of patient vengeance.

rites.name: Venerliel
rites.text: Venerliel is a shimmering veil of emerald solvent that a caster wears like a second skin, dissolving the blades and arrows that dare touch it. Anything that clutches the wearer is eaten away in a rush of hissing green, and those slain beneath it are reduced to a pool of slime. It is a ward woven from corrosion rather than force.

rites.name: Siluanira
rites.text: Siluanira is a whirling disk of raw force forged in the Arcane realm's E6 era, three ages old, that loops back on its creator if it misses. Its seeking mind reads the world through blind sensing, slicing through walls and cover alike.

rites.name: Siluannys
rites.text: Siluannys is a spell-born guardian woven into the living wood of the Miana highlands, where wardens awaken felled oaks and cedars to march beside them. Animated trunks uproot, stride with root-limbs, and swell to giant stature before fading back into dormant timber when their vitality is spent.

rites.name: Ilyimiorwen
rites.text: Ilyimiorwen is a rubbery shell of woven arcane force that its wardens conjure around a single ally in the age of Miana's third epoch. The shell soaks up blows aimed at its charge, growing thicker with each higher tier of invocation until it shatters under the last strain.

rites.name: Elilys
rites.text: Elilys is a corrosive mineral sap that seeps from the cracked roots of the Ossan Deeps, a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana. Its beams of greenish-gold reagent eat through armor, stone, and sorcery alike, and the spray it leaves behind lingers for days.

rites.name: Nuireth
rites.text: Nuireth is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a practice of slipping between the seams of the Arcane realm to arrive instantly at a chosen, visible point. Those caught along the path between departure and arrival feel their bodies strike hard against a rift of pressed force, tossing them off their feet unless they brace in time.

rites.name: Ryira
rites.text: Ryira is a concept of corrosive conjuration in the Miana omniverse, a binding that gathers caustic essence into a waiting palm and presses it against an opponent's skin. Its wielders are bound to the mending arts that undo its slow wear on armor. The concept is modest in scale, meant for duels and skirmishes rather than cosmic destruction.

rites.name: Ryaniel
rites.text: Ryaniel is a concept in the Miana omniverse, an Arcane-realm working of the third age in the E6 era. It turns gathered grass and conifer needles into brief, feather-light blades and missiles that vanish on impact or crumble to dust when the working ends.

rites.name: Nuimys
rites.text: Nuimys is a conjured sky-fire that waits behind a warrior's blade, then drops as a bolt of burning thunder to strike a foe the moment steel lands. Its flame clings to the target long after the spell has faded, demanding a deliberate act to smother it.

rites.name: Sileriolora
rites.text: Sileriolora is the ancient stone-guardian of the Mareth Quarry-Vaults, a spirit bound into the bedrock that answers the call of masons and wardens. It can tear a fist of rock from any earthen surface and hurl it across great distances, shattering walls and toppling foes with the weight of a mountain's root. Its name is still whispered by miners before they strike a new seam.

rites.name: Oriemae
rites.text: Oriemae is a dormant earth-attunement sigil in the Arcane realm of Miana, a spell-thread that lets its bearer sink into soil and stone as easily as a current carries a swimmer. In the ages after the Third Sundering, it was used by smugglers and grave-wardens who trusted the ground more than the sky.

rites.name: Miilwen
rites.text: Miilwen is a sorcerous working that turns ground into a rising, glowing sea of molten stone which snares and burns anything trapped in it, then hardens into black glass. Its slower form slowly builds volcanoes over years of patient casting.

rites.name: Alaareth
rites.text: Alaareth is a frost-keeping sigil that a warden of the Miana tides can snap into being, stilling a foe's blood or freezing a river into glass for a quarter hour. Its cold answers only to the warden's will, and the chill it leaves lingers in a body until it is warmed by a hearth.

rites.name: Oriana
rites.text: Oriana is the living hearth of Miana's arcane realm, a concept-being through whom the raw ember of burning flares outward whenever she chooses to let it. Within her radius, fire refuses every attempt at quenching and lays claim to any unclasped iron it finds.

rites.name: Miela
rites.text: Miela is a concept of living ember-fields, a kind of conditional flame that rises from the soil of the Arcane realm and burns until it is smothered. Its heat spreads outward with each rank of power woven into it, scorching anything that lingers within its bounds.

rites.name: Oriala
rites.text: Oriala is a minor conjuring art from the Arcane realm of Miana, letting a practitioner summon fleeting, translucent blades and shields that vanish once released. Its conjured arms are flimsy and carry no enchantment, yet they serve as a cheap, instant stand-in for real gear during a single decisive turn.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a minor fey spirit that takes the shape of a beast when called into being in the open spaces of Miana's Arcane realm. Its kind is bound to obey verbal commands and to vanish once its form is broken or its summoning fades.

rites.name: Orienala
rites.text: Orienala is a concept of Arcane power in the E6 era, a corrosive breath that pours from the bearer's palms in a long, narrow tongue of green vapor. Those caught in its path find their protective metals eaten away, and even stone and wood slowly soften where it lingers.

rites.name: Lyinys
rites.text: Lyinys is a storm-dancer's rite of the Miana arcane orders, a spinning strike that wraps the wielder in a cyclone of slicing wind. Its blades reach across the air to strike every foe the dancer names, while the gale scatters smoke and snuffs small flames nearby. Those caught in its wake find their aim thrown off for a full turn.

rites.name: Orianelwen
rites.text: Orianelwen is a frost-sorcery concept from the Arcane realm of Miana, from the sixth era of its age, drawing its power from the stillness of glacial deeps. Its practitioners can halt the water within a living body, locking muscle and blood until the chill is broken, and the rarest of them can turn a heart to clear ice.

rites.name: Alaimae
rites.text: Alaimae is a tidewoven charm sung into a lagoon's silt by the ferry-mothers of Miana's flooded delta. It grants the bearer gill-breath, a swimmer's grace, and immunity to the dark-water hexes that drown the unwary.

rites.name: Oriirae
rites.text: Oriirae is a shimmering sphere of conjured tidewater, woven by the Arcane realm's water-hearts to smother a single foe's breath and voice. Its pressure is measured in droplets rather than destruction, and its wielders treat it as a lesson in patience more than a weapon. Old tide-scribes record that when a bond is sealed deep enough, the sphere can hold a victim's lungs captive for a full heartbeat-counted age.

rites.name: Nuarys
rites.text: Nuarys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, born of the sediment of drowned mountain songs. It is said that its practitioners can stamp once and wake the stone beneath a crowd, scattering it in a ring of rising dust and shards. Its lore holds that the ground remembers every step and answers only those who stand upon it.

rites.name: Nualleirwen
rites.text: Nualleirwen is a primal earth-current that makes the ground of a vast cube liquefy while keeping its shape, dragging anything standing upon it downward into the depths. Its practitioners are known as tidewardens of the deep soil, who reshape battlefields and fortress foundations at will.

rites.name: Ilyerora
rites.text: Ilyerora is a concept of arcane counter-magic in the world of Miana, a reflexive bolt of storm-light that strikes a creature mid-trigger and staggers its will. It is a tool of the Arcane realm's sixth era, prized by wardens who must interrupt ruin before it takes hold.

rites.name: Lyinniel
rites.text: Lyinniel is a conjured lattice of elemental chains, born from the resonance of a dying ember-storm in the Arcane realm of Miana. Its strands lurch with hunger toward whatever they are bidden to bind, drawing captives inward and burning them with the element they were woven from. Its chains have been known to hold stellar wardens in place for a thousand years.

rites.name: Siliorys
rites.text: Siliorys is a rare conjured calamity from the Arcane realm of Miana, a sky-fallen stone that burns through the air before striking earth in a blossom of flame and ruin. Once it lands, its molten heart splits into a fire spirit and a stone giant that answer their summoner's voice for a short while.

rites.name: Ryameiriel
rites.text: Ryameiriel is an arcane sovereign of the Miana cycle who can unmake distance itself, flashing across any known reach in a blaze of storm-light. Her arrival detonates a storm column, a wall of scorching flame, and an earthquake that splits stone beneath her feet. She is remembered as the herald who first broke the sky over the seventh age.

rites.name: Venioleth
rites.text: Venioleth is a concept of bodily empowerment in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a caster's touch grants a chosen creature heightened strength or nimbleness for a time. Its power lies in sharpening the body and steadying the mind, so a warrior's blows land harder and their footing and focus hold firm.

rites.name: Silaenniel
rites.text: Silaenniel is a venom-sheathing rite of the Miana arcane orders, a fleeting enchantment that clothes a blade in sweet, lethal humours. Those who bear it are said to carry a sting that outlasts the wound it makes.

rites.name: Orieneth
rites.text: Orieneth is a sorcerer-engineer of the Arcane realm who claps once to release a sheet of volatile vapor that erupts into a burning barrier. Her art is shaping the blast's direction and length, so it can scorch a lane through a battlefield or a short wall to shelter her allies.

rites.name: Elaenys
rites.text: Elaenys is a storm-caller of the Arcane realm whose outstretched hands crackle with bolts that she can fling into four searing lanes across a fan of ground. Her strikes scorch foes who fail to dodge, and the fire they leave behind spreads to anything not clutched in a hand. Each extra channel she gathers at higher strength adds another lane to her lightning.

rites.name: Venanys
rites.text: Venanys is a kinetic-fire spell-form in the arcane realm of Miana, where a caster hurls a condensed core of burning force that strikes with both heat and crushing weight. Its wielders are rare, and the spell is said to have been first woven during the third age by scholars who sought to bend falling stars into a hand.

rites.name: Nuirliorys
rites.text: Nuirliorys is a gleaming ember-spell bound into steel, woken when a blade is drawn from its sheath. Wielders in the eastern forge-quarters call it the Hungry Dawn, for it lights a glow along the edge and scorches whatever it strikes. Those it sets alight burn until another hand smothers the flame.

rites.name: Miimiel
rites.text: Miimiel is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a fleeting flare of luminous power that erupts from a bearer's skin and collapses almost as soon as it appears. Those caught within its radius are struck blind for a short while, and their hostile reactions are dulled as the afterglow lingers.

rites.name: Alaereth
rites.text: Alaereth is a sorcerous rite in Miana's Arcane realm that wakes rooted growth and lends it borrowed fey spirits, so that a grove can rise and walk for a time at the caster's word. Each awakened growth fights as a massive, silent guardian, uprooting itself when the rite begins and resettling where it stands once the spirits withdraw.

rites.name: Alairlae
rites.text: Alairlae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a blade-sigil that channels a sworn strike into a wave of resonant force shaped like the blow itself. Wielders in the Third Age of the Arcane use it to reach foes beyond the length of their arm, and it sharpens with each rank of mastery.

rites.name: Veneirlora
rites.text: Veneirlora is a frost-glaze ward of the Arcane realm in the E6 era, lacquering a chosen warrior's armor with a brittle rime that numbs blows and slows those who dare strike close. Its practitioners in Miana teach that the cold never bites the wearer but always bites the attacker's resolve.

rites.name: Silemwen
rites.text: Silemwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a binding of wind-spirits to the blades a bearer grips. It lends keen edges a faint magic and a swelling of force, letting strikes reach past their natural length or fly true through gales and deep water.

rites.name: Venellora
rites.text: Venellora is a binding of luminous, spinning rings that the Drifting Choir of Oss forged from the echo of a collapsed moon's orbit. Those who wear the rings learn to tear brief doorways through space, stepping between points or threading their strikes through folds that shrink the distance to a foe.

rites.name: Venualys
rites.text: Venualys is an arcane concept that erupts as a caustic haze over solid ground, turning footing into treacherous foam. It burns those who stand or fall within its reach and lingers until its power fades.

rites.name: Miena
rites.text: Miena is a crystalline winter-storm sorcery of the Arcane realm, a whirl of rime and needle-sharp frost that answers a caster's call and bends around every obstacle. Its power grows with each higher rank of incantation, and wherever flame or searing heat touches its frozen ground, the ice dissolves at once.

rites.name: Nuiliel
rites.text: Nuiliel is a spell-craft of the Arcane realm in Miana, a hollow war-form that a caster seals herself within, moving its limbs through the grip of her own nerves. Its armored shell is grown from whatever is nearest, and it shrugs off blows that would kill the wearer outright.

rites.name: Nuemora
rites.text: Nuemora is a summoning-current of the Arcane realm that pulls the heavens' reservoirs down to a chosen ground, drowning a basin in a flood that sinks back into the sky in minutes. It is valued by the drowned-plain cartographers of Miana, who use its measured rise to chart old lowlands.

rites.name: Nuinuallys
rites.text: Nuinuallys is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a restorative rite in which a willing creature is briefly kindled to its own healing powers. It purges one affliction and mends wounds, at the price of a lingering weariness.

rites.name: Oriirelwen
rites.text: Oriirelwen is a concept-born voice of the Arcane realm in Miana, worn by a speaker who can drive their words into roaring waves that shove crowds and stone alike. Her thunderous calls ripple outward across the fields of the third age, and those who falter beneath them stay rattled for a long while after.

rites.name: Mielora
rites.text: Mielora is a veil of woven starlight that a mage in the Miana omniverse draws across a body or a living creature, lasting only until the caster's next breath of intent. It drinks the first blows aimed at its charge, bleeding its own luminous threads until they fray, and what it cannot absorb falls through to the wearer.

rites.name: Elaena
rites.text: Elaena is a radiant sigil that hangs above a touched creature, wrapping it in borrowed glory so that speech and presence carry extra weight. Whoever strikes the bearer finds a sudden beam of light lancing back at them from the crown above.

rites.name: Alailae
rites.text: Alailae is a concept of a tide of restorative light that swells outward from a caster and washes over chosen companions within reach. Its recurring pulse returns to the faithful each new dawn of their turn, though it turns away from the hollow dead and the unliving. Its power grows with the depth of the reserves poured into it.

rites.name: Alainiel
rites.text: Alainiel is a stifling wind-spirit of the Arcane realm of Miana, born from the breath of a dying desert star-court. It drifts through the air as a sweltering, sickly haze that clings to the lungs and drains the strength of anyone who breathes it.

rites.name: Lyinnys
rites.text: Lyinnys is a concept of a judging radiance drawn down from the upper vault of the Miana sky, a column of pale fire that finds one chosen figure within sight and presses it to its knees. The pillar's weight is measured against the observer's will, so the less resolved the target, the longer the afterglow lingers in their nerves. Scholars of the Arcane realm classify it as a tool of mercy disguised as a hammer.

rites.name: Lyirlora
rites.text: Lyirlora is a radiant aura-bearer of the Arcane realm in Miana, a being who, with a single word, wraps itself in a spinning ring of light that burns and reproaches those who draw near.
