Its glow sears attackers at the close of their turns and blinds the perceptions of chosen allies' enemies, though its power tapers off beyond its immediate sphere.

rites.name: Ilyinnae
rites.text: Ilyinnae is a silent void-sphere, a bell of stolen air that the Miani wardens of the Hushing Reach place over a point they can see. Anything caught inside is stripped of breath and voice and weighed down by a creeping fatigue that lifts only once it steps back into the open. It is considered a mercy in the old war-codes and a cruelty by everyone who has lived through it.

rites.name: Venuamiel
rites.text: Venuamiel is a hunting rite of the Miana arcane orders, in which a practitioner loosing a missile calls down a predator-spirit that streaks alongside the arrow and tears into the mark. The spirit lingers only to finish its quarry, then answers its summoner's whistle until it fades.

rites.name: Ilyennae
rites.text: Ilyennae is a concept of a pale luminous thread that a caster draws from the marrow of their own intent, cast as a single lance of coruscating force. It singes the target's nerves with a sharp, singing ache that leaves the victim momentarily unable to answer with any reflexive counter. Within the Arcane realm of Miana it is regarded as a craft of precision rather than ruin.

rites.name: Eleirlarys
rites.text: Eleirlarys is a concept of restorative radiance in the arcane realm of Miana, a bloom of warm light that gathers over a chosen point and mends up to four willing bodies within its reach. Those already standing receive a lingering shield of vitality, and the bloom grows richer when drawn from a higher tier of power.

rites.name: Nuarlaelys
rites.text: Nuarlaelys is a rite of the Deepwrit tradition in the Miana omniverse, wherein a caster coaxes the stone beneath a foe into liquid rebellion. The earth yields like wet clay, drawing the victim down into a sealed hollow where it must claw its way back toward light.

rites.name: Venaemys
rites.text: Venaemys is a compact arcane discipline in which a practitioner shapes a fleeting sphere of gathered sand, mist, or brine and hurls it at a visible foe before it dissolves at the turn's end. It is a humble craft of the Arcane realm, taught early and valued for its reliability rather than its force.

rites.name: Nuarora
rites.text: Nuarora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's third age, a flickering lattice of sword-light that a caster weaves into a long, thin wall of cutting edges. Its blades hang in the air for as long as the caster's will holds them, sliding their ends across the battlefield to herd and slice whatever crosses their path.

rites.name: Elameth
rites.text: Elameth is a mass-restorative rite of the Miana arcane tradition, drawing the body's own mending instincts into a single bright tide that knits up to twenty willing or unconscious souls at once. The cost is borne in exhaustion, and the weakest of the healed may fall into a deep stillness that only a full night's rest can break.

rites.name: Silaemys
rites.text: Silaemys is a lattice of woven resonance that the Arcane Choir of Miana raised as a shield for their wardbearers. It flares into a shimmering veil that guards the chosen companions against a single strike and lingers to turn aside lesser blasts until the next dawn of the caster's tempo.

rites.name: Nuelora
rites.text: Nuelora is a bramble-cult sorcery of the Arcane realm, drawing root-wardens from the soil to wrestle and fling foes across the wilds of Miana. Its roots are sturdy enough to hurl a stone fortress wall, yet they remain a tool of local magic bound to the ground.

rites.name: Eluamereth
rites.text: Eluamereth is a concept in the Miana omniverse, an arcane bond that lets up to six chosen companions slip short distances at will while their caster can pull them together across open ground. Its reach ends at a fixed radius and never crosses into another plane, so distant or otherworldly allies are left behind. Within those limits, it is the favored tactic of Miana's wandering scouts and rescuers.

rites.name: Lyinneireth
rites.text: Lyinneireth is a fire-born earth-ordeal of the Miana Arcane realm, an ember-heart that cracks open the ground beneath enemies and seals it again as black glass. Its ruptures are said to remember every footstep that crossed them during the age of the Third Scarring.

rites.name: Eleinwen
rites.text: Eleinwen is a sovereign of the Arcane realm in the era of the sixth dominion, a lattice-born being whose radiance is said to have once carved a valley through the Veyrun ridges. She channels her will into a single lance of brilliant force that scours everything within its path and leaves the air ringing for leagues.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is a radiant spirit of the Miana arcane courts who dissolves into living light for a single hour of rest. In that form it cannot be bound, grows nearly untouchable, and its spells burn with a dazzling extra brilliance.

rites.name: Eliorameth
rites.text: Eliorameth is a crystalline transformation that turns a caster's whole body into living prismatic glass for a short while, letting them shrug off sickness and toxins without curing them. While it lasts, every spell they cast can be channeled through their gleaming form to strike foes with force or radiant light that bypasses resistance.

rites.name: Venaellys
rites.text: Venaellys is a volcanic sorcerer of the Arcane realm, age three in the sixth era, who can dissolve their flesh into molten arcane magma. In that form they shrug off flame and nearly all harm, and they can reach out with a glowing limb to seize foes in a searing grip.

rites.name: Eleilimora
rites.text: Eleilimora is a resonant-metal transformation that turns the whole body into a ringing alloy, carrying a single chosen edge of force through every strike. In the arcane era of Miana, its wielders are feared for shrugging off poison and disease while their voices carry across battlefields.

rites.name: Miilionwen
rites.text: Miilionwen is a concept of glacial vapour, a being that dissolves into a drifting frost-cloud and reforms at will. Its mist blankets the air, smothers ordinary fire and drags foes to the frozen ground. Old Miana's sorcerers still speak of its breath as a weather that remembers grudges.

rites.name: Nuanae
rites.text: Nuanae is a petrifying amber lance of earth-bound force drawn from the stone roots of Miana's deep mantle. Its bearers can stiffen a foe's limb into inert rock, though the stone cracks and deforms anyone whose petrified limb shatters.

rites.name: Oriereima
rites.text: Oriereima is a plasma cord woven by Miana's arcane artisans during the sixth era, a luminous lash that can strike several foes at once. Its wielders call its crack a lighthouse of the mind, as it bends attention and sears through defenses.

rites.name: Silualimae
rites.text: Silualimae is a dormant ember-spirit of the Arcane realm that wakes only when a mind chooses to kindle something. Its power lets the Miana-born ignite a single creature or unattended object with a glance, though the flame clings stubbornly until a faith-fed quench snuffs it.

rites.name: Ryamwen
rites.text: Ryamwen is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, an earth-bound ritual-dance that bends the soil into soft, springing ground. Its practitioners stamp and grind their feet to drop rivals to the dirt and leave the terrain treacherous for any who follow. Ryamwen manifests only where a practitioner stands upon the ground, and it fades with the practitioner's focus.

rites.name: Elinneila
rites.text: Elinneila is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, a lightning ward that arcs through the weapon of any foe who strikes at its caster, shocking the wielder and disarming them if they fail to resist. Its volt-sparks are small in scale, meant to sting and rattle rather than to shatter, and it is well known among the duellists of the Vell-Shard guilds.

rites.name: Ryanneilae
rites.text: Ryanneilae is a verdant arcane sentience that lives within the sap-streams of Miana's oldest groves, able to animate any stray leaf or blade into a lethal missile. Its gift is to lend a stem's flight a sliver of its ancient will, so that even a plucked needle can pierce a hillside's bedrock. It is regarded as a quiet, patient guardian of the forest's boundaries.

rites.name: Orianiel
rites.text: Orianiel is a concept of enduring warding-light in the arcane realm of Miana, a radiance that is laid upon a living body by touch and sustains it. While the light holds, each renewed breath of the bearer knits small wounds closed and cloaks them in a fresh barrier of gleaming resilience.

rites.name: Siluameth
rites.text: Siluameth is an arcane concept in the Miana universe from the sixth era, a binding that lets a caster reposition a creature by touch. A willing subject slips through short distances to any open space within sight, while an unwilling one must first be caught by a spell-strike and then fail a test of will. Its craft is precision rather than power, favored by couriers and rescuers who must move people without tearing them apart.

rites.name: Venamys
rites.text: Venamys is a concept of gentle vital magic in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a healer's touch quickens the body's own mending. Its power is bounded so that a creature may only draw on a limited measure of restorative reserves before rest renews them.

rites.name: Elerys
rites.text: Elerys is a concept of quiet restoration in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a single spoken word draws a warm current of vital light into a wounded body. The flow mends flesh and shields the recipient for a short span, though lifeless shells and animated constructs remain untouched by its kindness.

rites.name: Elaereth
rites.text: Elaereth is a sonic weapon-spirit of the Arcane realm, a resonant hum that its bearers can call forth as nauseating vibrations. Its song fills a broad sphere around any point chosen, shattering stone and crystal while sickening the living within.

rites.name: Orieramwen
rites.text: Orieramwen is a consecrated tide that rises from quiet pools and rain-filled hollows in the Arcane realm, binding itself to whatever water it touches. Those who wade through its shining current find that the water burns away the unnatural and the wild, though it spares the faithful. Its sanctity lasts only as long as the rite that called it, unless a patient hand renews the vow on the same ground for a full year.

rites.name: Lyanwen
rites.text: Lyanwen is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, a drifting veil of grit that a wielder can stretch wide or draw tight around themselves. Its blinding gusts are mostly a nuisance, though a single act of its power can flay open a mountain's ridge and tear a flat stretch of desert into glass.

rites.name: Nuanaerora
rites.text: Nuanaerora is a sand-storm concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's third age, a towering column of grit that can be summoned over any visible point and nudged across the field. Its authored energies rise far above a typical storm but stay well below cosmic scale.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a silvery barrier of solid force conjured by mages of the Arcane realm, able to rise as a wall twenty feet across and high. Its shimmering panels stop blows and spells alike, yet let watchers glimpse what waits beyond through their pale glow.

rites.name: Miinneirae
rites.text: Miinneirae is an arcane geomancer-spirit of Miana's third age, a presence that wakes beneath the soil when the earth is asked to rise. Its acts lift stone plates from the bedrock and bring them together in a cube-shaped crush that leaves the ground jagged and slow to heal.

rites.name: Venuallaema
rites.text: Venuallaema is a warding current of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a shimmering veil that a caster weaves over allies to blunt one chosen kind of harm. It is bound for a set span and stretches further with each greater level of working. Its power is modest against cosmic threats but vital in the small battles of mortal life.

rites.name: Silarlae
rites.text: Silarlae is the name given to the drifting veil of crystallized moonlight that the Thessene wardsingers weave between colliding fates in the age of the sixth dawning. It bends away any blow aimed at its bearer and dissolves the luminous darts of spellcraft into harmless motes of frost.

rites.name: Oriimiolla
rites.text: Oriimiolla is a concept of weightless plated light that wraps its bearer in a luminous shell, scorching any foe who strikes it. When a blow would be critical, the shell detonates in a blinding flare that disrupts nearby attackers before dissolving away.

rites.name: Ilyemae
rites.text: Ilyemae is a sand-wyrm sorcery of the dune-cults of Miana, a shifting spiral of drowning grit that swallows a whole plaza at a glance. Those caught are slowly drawn toward its heart until the spell's dissolution crushes them into the reclaimed stone beneath.

rites.name: Mienys
rites.text: Mienys is a concept of thunderous force, a bead of compressed sound-energy that a practitioner of the Arcane realm of Miana launches toward a visible point, where it bursts into a shockwave. Its power scales with the level of the spell slot used to channel it.

rites.name: Ilyerlys
rites.text: Ilyerlys is a rite of the Vael-Hollow mystics in which the wild spirits of the Miana forests are coaxed into bodies of fur, fang, and claw. Ten such beasts pour out as a single frenzied tide, shredding anything caught in their path. The tide has no mercy, and a wise caster knows the spirits will not stop until the last of them has fallen.

rites.name: Lyareth
rites.text: Lyareth is an arcane concept in the Miana universe, a sleep-and-stillness working drawn from the cold, distant glow of ancient starlight. It binds a single watcher's will in silent dim radiance until the bound mind breaks free or is roused by a gentle hand.

rites.name: Sileilora
rites.text: Sileilora is a luminous rift-stride, a dimensional step that folds the traveler from one point of the visible sky to another. Its exit flare is a blinding burst of starlight that scorches and staggers everyone nearby, though those who brace are spared most of it. Scholars of the Arcane realm regard it as the first art to bend the dark between stars into a usable path.

rites.name: Silioluarys
rites.text: Silioluarys is a scalding vapor-serpent that coils through the Arcane realm of Miana, blinding and boiling whatever it strikes in a shroud of hissing mist. Its heat is drawn from the sealed furnaces of forgotten glass-cities, and it fades only when a breeze carries its fog away.

rites.name: Venallora
rites.text: Venallora is a living spell-thicket in the Arcane realm of Miana, a grove that answers a caster's call by erupting into branch-cages at chosen points. Its wooden lattices close around anyone beneath them, laced with venom-slick vines that drain the trapped over time.

rites.name: Nuilana
rites.text: Nuilana is a concept of stone-calling that draws hard earth from a nearby surface and flings it at distant foes. Its power grows with the rank of the calling, letting a practitioner hurl additional stones each time the working is deepened. In the Miana omniverse it is a modest, reliable art of the Arcane realm.

rites.name: Oriiniolla
rites.text: Oriiniolla is a bottled storm-sprite of the Miana arcane courts, a spark-form that threads itself through willing marrow and sharpens every motion into a crackling blur. Its wielders are remembered by the pale scorch-marks they leave on doorframes and the ringing silence after their passing.

rites.name: Alaalenwen
rites.text: Alaalenwen is a crackling lance of storm-light conjured from the air of the Miana sky-reaches, favored by sky-wardens who bind thunder into fleeting weapons. It strikes at a chosen foe and locks their limbs in arcs of paralysis until they break free of its hum.

rites.name: Sileinamwen
rites.text: Sileinamwen is a dormant fey-elemental tide that sleeps beneath the mosses of Miana's oldest groves, waking only when a bark-wrapped totem is laid upon its roots. Those who earn its favour may call its shape forth as a sentient avatar, a loyal echo of the sleeper that breaks stone and bends the wind alike.

rites.name: Lyimae
rites.text: Lyimae is a sun-blossom of pale spectral petals that unfolds over a chosen patch of ground, casting a warm radiance across its surroundings for as long as it endures. In its ripest moments the bloom can loose a blazing flare of sunlight, scorching a cylinder, cone, or narrow lance of the battlefield or striking a single distant foe. It is a summoned wonder of the Arcane realm, strongest against the restless dead and the formless slimes.

rites.name: Alaarina
rites.text: Alaarina is a storm-veil conjured by weavers of the Marrow Choir, a spiraling cylinder of drifting rain, silver mist, and crackling air that hangs over a chosen spot and grows wider with each deliberate surge of will. Its pulses strike everyone inside, and the longer the veil endures, the more fiercely its lightning answers any who dare to stand within it.

rites.name: Miema
rites.text: Miema is a hasty shimmer of arcane force, a concept woven in the Arcane realm of Miana during its third age. It is a reactive veil that drinks in blows meant for its bearer and dissolves once it has absorbed all it can hold.

rites.name: Oriarennae
rites.text: Oriarennae is a gentle spell-craft of the Arcane realm, letting a weaver coax flora within a small cube to repaint leaves into written words, shake loose their ripe harvest, or knot themselves into tangles. Its effects are modest and fleeting, lasting an hour at most, and it cannot uproot anything or bruise a living thing.

rites.name: Nuirlaerys
rites.text: Nuirlaerys is a stonebound lance-working drawn from the bedrock of Miana's third age, when the old mountain-cults first learned to coax spikes of living earth from any grounded surface. It is a small, precise art, requiring a foot of honest stone beneath the target and yielding a spike that shatters into dust once its piercing work is done.

rites.name: Oriamiel
rites.text: Oriamiel is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a discipline of focused pressure that rolls a single foe off their footing. Its practitioners in the third age of the sixth era use it to clear crowded thoroughfares and topple sentries without drawing blood.

rites.name: Silirae
rites.text: Silirae is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a sustained tide of vital light that a binder kindles in a single soul, knitting wounds closed even as they open. Its mending spreads outward to nearby allies, and the bound one endures past the threshold of collapse until the tide finally ebbs.

rites.name: Lyinerora
rites.text: Lyinerora is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a cold-breathing silence that drifts from the lungs of its bearer as a pale, sweet mist. Those caught in its reach feel their blood thicken and their limbs grow heavy for a time, and the mist lingers in the lungs of the unwary long after it has thinned.

rites.name: Siliomae
rites.text: Siliomae is a sorcerous fire-form that bursts from the back of a caster and whirls about the legs as a cyclone of flame, carrying the bearer across the battlefield in a blaze of motion. Its flames scorch the ground behind and launch rivals aside when the bearer passes through them.

rites.name: Elerwen
rites.text: Elerwen is a conceptual art of the Arcane realm that raises a molten barrier from bare stone, sealing whatever stands within its span. Those caught in it burn and cling fast, and any stretch of the barrier frozen by cold-bearing force hardens into black glass that holds its shape.

rites.name: Orienora
rites.text: Orienora is a concept of a sprayed jet of compressed arcane water, drawn from a reservoir of stagnant brine that can be coaxed into a forceful torrent. Its jet bludgeons foes and shoves them back, then dissolves into nothing the moment its work is finished. Within the Miana omniverse it is a modest tool of the powers, never meant to endure.

rites.name: Alaameireth
rites.text: Alaameireth is a concept-kind power of the Arcane realm in the Miana universe, a binding that lets a caster sour a stretch of water within a sealed cube into a corrosive solution that refuses to spread. Its shape is fixed by the caster's sight, and the poison reverts to plain water once the binding lapses, leaving no trace in the water itself.

rites.name: Miirleth
rites.text: Miirleth is a conjured tide-whip, a lash of living water drawn from the caster's arm and bound to their will for as long as their concentration holds. In the hands of a practiced duelist it can drag a foe off their feet, though its true strength lies in how tightly it can be woven with the tides of the wider Miana cosmos.

rites.name: Miennaellae
rites.text: Miennaellae, a temporal concept in the Miana's Arcane realm, accelerates an object's aging process, instantaneously advancing it by three days. This power, known as 'Chronosis', transforms items based on their material properties and environmental conditions, mimicking the effects of prolonged time passage. It cannot affect magical items or spells.

rites.name: Nuellae
rites.text: Nuellae is a concept of directed windstorm in the Arcane realm of Miana, a cyclonic force that gathers the air into a roaring cone and sweeps through anything it touches. It is an invocation of the era's stormcraft, shaped to bend crowds and drag foes toward its caster.

rites.name: Alaimora
rites.text: Alaimora is a windborne working in the Arcane realm of Miana, where a practitioner summons a moving cyclone that travels with them and bends the wind to their will. It scatters gas and smothers flame, and no arrow can cut through it. Its authored capacity reflects a modest spell-level force that a single mage can wield for a short while.

rites.name: Oriilaeriel
rites.text: Oriilaeriel is a sphere of sparkling dim light that a caster conjures over a chosen point, mending the wounded who step into it and lingering as a sanctuary until its brief span ends. When it fades, the stored reserves of mending are returned to ten chosen allies, so the healing it offered is never wasted. The sphere cannot restore the dead-touched or the made-things, leaving them untouched by its glow.

rites.name: Silualys
rites.text: Silualys is a sealed resonance-principle that governs how harmonies bind across the Miana realms of the Arcane era. It is studied as a lens for reading the thrum of leyline currents, and it bends only where two tuning forks of the same pitch are struck together.

rites.name: Lyireth
rites.text: Lyireth is a dormant ember-spirit that wakes whenever another being clasps it in struggle, scorching the grip with a flare of heat that the bearer must recover from before the spirit can burn again. Old wardens of the Arcane Reach reportedly bound it into gloves and chains to fight in close quarters.

rites.name: Mianilwen
rites.text: Mianilwen is a quiet arcane discipline in the Miana cosmos, taught in the sixth age as a way of lending the body a lighter, faster stride through layered wards of breath and sigil. Its practitioners are known for crossing long distances on foot without tiring, a skill that has reshaped trade routes and border patrols. The art remains modest in scale, measured in streets rather than mountains.

rites.name: Elaniel
rites.text: Elaniel is a concept of stone-skinned resilience in the Arcane realm of Miana, born in the third age of the E6 era. Its body hardens into a natural shell that lets it resist blows without any forged protection, and it can brace behind a shield for even greater defense.

rites.name: Ilyamiel
rites.text: Ilyamiel is a concept of frost-bound reckoning in the Arcane realm of Miana, a discipline that reads the hidden histories of frozen sculpture. Its adepts trace how each carved glacier was shaped, marking the cold that set every chisel-stroke into place.

rites.name: Silionamys
rites.text: Silionamys is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a discipline of frost-walking woven through the sixth age of arcane lore. Practitioners glide over ice and drifted snow as though the ground were level, and they keep their footing when the world beneath them turns treacherous. Its lesser rites grant only surefootedness, not destructive power.

rites.name: Miemaeneth
rites.text: Miemaeneth is a gentle concept of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, a lattice of drifting glow-motes that answers to the quiet resolve of whoever calls it. Born only three ages ago, it is a delicate illumination that bends shadows into dancing ribbons of color. Its feats remain small and luminous, a reflection of its youthful, playful nature.

rites.name: Veniolaerys
rites.text: Veniolaerys is a dormant sigil-current woven through the ley-lattice of the Arcane realm, sixth of its age, that hums whenever bright light touches its runes. It turns stray radiance into a shield of glimmering veil, so that dazzling flares wash over its bearers without harm and their eyes stay open against sudden glare.

rites.name: Lyeneirlae
rites.text: Lyeneirlae is a veil-spun concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a standing pattern of threaded starlight that moves between shapes of memory and wind. It is said to hold the echo of a sealed sunrise within its lattice, and it reshapes nearby law in quiet ripples.

rites.name: Veneimwen
rites.text: Veneimwen is a whispered grove-tongue, a concept of the Arcane realm that lets its bearer speak to green things so they grasp every word, though the answers stay hidden in leaf-rustle. Old orchard-wardens claimed that persuasion came easier to them than to any mortal, since roots listen closer than men do.

rites.name: Venilla
rites.text: Venilla is a spellwork principle in the Miana omniverse, a discipline in which a caster coaxes living growth from the soil through a gentle, voiced bond. Its practitioners are sought out by farmers and wardens who need hedges to grow across a ruined field overnight. The tradition holds that green things answer to warmth and invitation far more readily than to command.

rites.name: Sileirlirys
rites.text: Sileirlirys is a quiet arcane principle in the Arcane realm of Miana, sustaining the living through the slow intake of light and pure water. Its scholars describe it as a tide that carries nourishment into the body without the need for any meal.

rites.name: Silaelwen
rites.text: Silaelwen is a loom-spirit of the Miana weave, a being who threads starlight through living bark and the silver veins of old elves. Her songs can unmake the seams between worlds, and she is said to remember every dawn since the first root broke the soil.

rites.name: Venaelanora
rites.text: Venaelanora is a concept of silent ascent woven into the arcane fabric of the Miana's sixth age, a power that lets the bearer climb sheer surfaces as easily as walking and leap across chasms with twice their natural reach. Mages of the era studied it as a lesson in how gravity can be politely negotiated rather than defied.

rites.name: Lyimeirlys
rites.text: Lyimeirlys is a silent glyph of the Arcane realm, born six eras ago when the Miana's first ink dried on a sky-scroll. It is less a being than a stillness that answers to whoever learns to listen to its hush.

rites.name: Elannerys
rites.text: Elannerys is a silver-threaded hymn of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, sung by lantern-keepers who slip between moments of the ninth tide. Its most famous working is the quiet step, a grace that lets a bearer vanish from attention and walk away before the world notices.

rites.name: Mielora
rites.text: Mielora is a concept of a pocket-sized arcane wayfarer who measures no more than a squirrel's span, moving through the world with a light, deliberate gait. In the Arcane realm of the sixth era, she is known as a threadwalker who slips through the hidden seams between enchanted places.

rites.name: Alaanneriel
rites.text: Alaanneriel is a veil-weave of the Miana arcane realm, a discipline that lets its practitioners slip between the outlines of greater beings as though the bulk were a thinning mist. The weave falters at extremes, refusing passage through forms that are either vastly smaller or vastly larger than the walker.

rites.name: Silineth
rites.text: Silineth is a concept of quiet sorcery in Miana's Arcane realm, a discipline that tames fire by stilling it rather than feeding it. Its practitioners can smother a blaze or shape embers into simple figures, and once per rest they can call up a thick drifting mist from the air. Its power is modest, but in the E6 era it is prized as a gentle craft.

rites.name: Elera
rites.text: Elera is a sun-touched concept of the Arcane realm, a discipline of living ember-shaping that thrives under scorching skies in the sixth age of Miana. Practitioners draw heat from the air and bend it into lasting glassy sheets and kindled storms.

rites.name: Ryamiel
rites.text: Ryamiel is a frost-hardened warden of the Miana concordance, a ward-principle that rides the cold currents of the northern vault. Their stride cannot be slowed by winter's bite, though a chain or a locked grip can still halt them outright.

rites.name: Elaenneirae
rites.text: Elaenneirae is a frost-woven mantle of the Miana Arcane Reach, a concept that lets a wearer call down glittering sculpted ice and sleeting storms once each before resting. Its wearers are said to bind winter into their own veins, so that every blow they receive returns a cold reckoning. The mantle's power grows as the bearer ages in discipline and endurance.

rites.name: Mierluareth
rites.text: Mierluareth is a bound-speech of the Arcane realm in the third age of the Miana cycle, a cantrip of primal wildness that wakes the beast in whoever speaks it. Its practitioners trade a little of their own endurance for brief surges of raw force, and the Miana tutors teach the rite as either a surge of ferocity or a bite of corrosive dew.

rites.name: Ilyinys
rites.text: Ilyinys is a slippery arcane discipline in the Miana omniverse, practiced by wanderers who learn to unbind their bodies from chains, coils, and narrow gaps. Its adepts reshape the flow of their own mass so that restraints find nothing solid to hold. Within the sixth age it is taught quietly in border towns where escapes are often the only currency of freedom.

rites.name: Veniomualys
rites.text: Veniomualys is a conceptual arcane art in the third age of the Miana cosmos, drawn from the bodily resilience of its practitioners rather than from any external source. Its adepts channel the endurance of their own constitution into a small number of sudden sparks and gusts, each renewed only after a full rest. Its power is modest by the standards of the realm, yet fitted to the frail margins of mortal life.

rites.name: Elaeriomys
rites.text: Elaeriomys is a hardy wayfarer's discipline of the Arcane realm, taught in the sixth age of Miana to those who walk the frozen and fevered borderlands. Practitioners endure long stretches without sustenance and recover their strength swiftly through brief rests, while their bodies shrug off plague and the bite of extreme weather. Its adepts are prized as guides and sentinels across the wild marches.

rites.name: Sileilae
rites.text: Sileilae is a veiled principle of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, the hidden grammar by which the wardens of Vell bind kindled matter into obedient forms. Those who take its discipline read the world as a set of interlocking resonances that can be tuned like strings.

rites.name: Ryala
rites.text: Ryala is a silent lattice of resonant glass that hums whenever enchantment lingers nearby, a sense of the Miana aether first mapped by hermit-scholars of the Vell Coast. Its pulse is faint and uncanny, a whisper of old wards rather than any weapon. It is a tool of quiet perception, never of force.

rites.name: Miirlioriel
rites.text: Miirlioriel is a whispered rite of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a breath-craft drawn from the lungs of the wind-keepers of the third age. Its practitioners learn to exhale a sudden, shaped current that can topple sparring novices and scatter dust from ancient stone halls.

rites.name: Lyariomwen
rites.text: Lyariomwen is a dormant resonance of stone-bound breath in the Arcane realm of Miana, a quiet sense that lets a bearer slip through soil and rock as though it were air. Its keepers in the sixth age claim immunity to venom and the slow weight of petrifying stone. Its power is modest but steady, woven into the earth's own patience.

rites.name: Venimora
rites.text: Venimora is a tidewoven sorcery of the Miana archipelago, drawing currents from the nearest body of water into shaped force. Its practitioners are said to read the lanes of the sea as easily as a scholar reads script. Its most feared working can split a bay open in a single breath.

rites.name: Veniomae
rites.text: Veniomae is a tidal current-weaver of the Miana powers, able to bend the pull of deep water into a lasting, rippling wake. Its greatest act is to split a sea trench open, though it can sustain its own submersion through long, slow pressures.

rites.name: Venaelerwen
rites.text: Venaelerwen is a sun-tempered weave of arcane heat that its practitioners draw into their own bodies, letting them walk through furnaces and deserts unharmed. In the Sixth Age of Miana, the weave is taught only in the glassy towers of the southern dunes, where apprentices learn to channel captured sunfire.

rites.name: Siluamiel
rites.text: Siluamiel is a concept of corrosive dissolution in the Arcane realm of Miana, a hungering force that eats through matter and leaves behind a slick, sour residue. In the third age of the sixth era it is remembered as the patient rot that undoes stone and steel alike. Its influence is measured in the slow unmaking of places rather than in sudden blasts.

rites.name: Nuinae
rites.text: Nuinae is a concept of pact-bound storm magic, a sworn bond with an azure wyrm whose lightning answers to the caster's will. Its channels range from a sparking flicker to a short-lived storm sphere, and at full strength its bolts can strike a city's power grid like judgment.

rites.name: Siliorlora
rites.text: Siliorlora is a concept of living brass-flame that the people of Miana's Arcane realm call the patient kindling, a spark that remembers every hearth it has warmed. In its third age it learned to gather heat into rays, bursts and shielding veils, though it is said to refuse any blaze that would consume a whole city.

rites.name: Alaimuarys
rites.text: Alaimuarys is a storm-tongued sorcerer of the Arcane realm in the third age of the Miana cycle, who inherited a pact with a bronze wyrm that taught spells of thunder, tidal crush, and forked light. Her signature working gathers the sky's fury into a sphere that can lash the horizon, as she has been known to do during the great drought of her youth.

rites.name: Ryimora
rites.text: Ryimora is a bronze-scaled mindspeaker of the Vellarin Concord, a patron-bound caster whose pact flows from an ancient acid-breathing drake sleeping beneath the salt flats of Hesk. Her spells corrode, slick, and swallow the battlefield in layered sheets of noxious chemistry rather than fire or lightning. She tutors apprentices in the careful art of dissolving stone and bone alike.

rites.name: Silinora
rites.text: Silinora is a sigil-woven ember-lattice, a concept that binds a dormant solar flare into a crystalline lens. Its wielders are said to draw warmth from the old brightness of a sun that has since burned out. In Miana's Arcane realm, it is used to forge and to shield, never to destroy.

rites.name: Nuiliel
rites.text: Nuiliel is the Verdant Pact's lantern-spirit of pale, poisonous mists, a concept-entity that teaches its devotees how to exhale rot and sweeten blades with venom. In Miana's Arcane realm during the sixth epoch, it is three ages old and still fragile, its power bound to the lungs of those who serve it.

rites.name: Veneileth
rites.text: Veneileth is a flame-wrought pact-spirit of the Miana arcane plane, bound to mortal casters who draw her ember-fire through sigils of ash and brass. Her fire is measured in spellcraft rather than raw devastation, yet in her age she has learned to fold scorched sanctuaries into a single blaze.

rites.name: Ryerliel
rites.text: Ryerliel is a frost-and-mist arcane pattern woven into the Miana powers, drawing its strength from the cold breath of ancient silver wyrms. Its practitioners learn to gather fog, bend winds, and seal the air itself into brittle sheets of ice.

rites.name: Ryareth
rites.text: Ryareth is a frost-bound sorcerous art of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, drawing its cold from the glacial veins of the Third Age's northern wastes. Practitioners learn to coax stillness, shape ice into lasting forms, and summon storms whose breath can hollow out whole valleys. Its discipline is revered for patience, since each working borrows heat that must eventually be repaid.

rites.name: Ryilamora
rites.text: Ryilamora is a sealed ember-glass reliquary that hums with the stored exhalations of a drowned wyrm of the Miana deeps. Its bearer may draw a scatter of crimson sparks from the shell and loose them as a burst of heat across a chosen patch of ground. The reliquary's power grows slowly with each generation of keepers who sing to it.

rites.name: Elionna
rites.text: Elionna is a concept of the Arcane realm in Miana, a bloodline-sorcery where a chosen wielder absorbs a sliver of a dragon-god's living fire. The essence grants immunity to the flame it channels and lets a single fearsome aura be pressed upon foes who suffer that same burning.

rites.name: Silenirla
rites.text: Silenirla is a concept of hardened, crystalline resonance drawn from the Arcane Realm's oldest tide-bells, a sheltering pattern that flares just before harm arrives. It holds its shield for a single cycle and must rest before it can be summoned again. Its energy is modest, measured against the scale of the wider realm.

rites.name: Elaena
rites.text: Elaena is a frost-rune lattice woven into the marrow of Miana's oldest ice-hermits, a discipline that lets them pierce cold-proofed defenses by reading the death-ember hidden inside each creature. Practitioners who cross its unmade threshold can turn a creature's own wound-chill against it, doubling the harm of any necrotic weakness they expose.

rites.name: Miirioleth
rites.text: Miirioleth is a corrosive hymn-current woven by the Tallow Choirs of the Miana wastes, a concept that dissolves wards by singing the acid of old stars into them. Its binding turns resistances into brittle seams, letting the acid bite where it normally could not unless the target is already braced against force. Sages measure its reach in the thinning of vaults and armour rather than in any single scorched wound.

rites.name: Venaera
rites.text: Venaera is a quiet discipline that lets a practitioner bind their spirit to one of four primal currents after each full rest, reshaping how they breathe, stand, and endure. Its later masters are said to have drawn the same four currents into a single dying sun to hold back its collapse for a generation.

rites.name: Venamae
rites.text: Venamae is a lattice of storm-glass filaments woven through the ley-currents of the Arcane realm, a conduit that channels lightning stripped of its usual defenses. Practitioners of the Miana tradition tune it to slip past the armour of any creature, so that its strikes bypass ordinary shielding unless the target carries a counter-light ward. Its scope is measured in the reach of a single spell rather than in planetary force.

rites.name: Oriennys
rites.text: Oriennys is a frost-binding silence woven into the Arcane realm of Miana during its third age, where cold magic can steal a foe's voice for a short while. Those who learn it can press a wintry quiet onto a struck creature, forcing a test of its mind, and the silence then sinks in deeply. The rite may be drawn only once before the caster must rest through a full night's stillness.

rites.name: Lyarlinae
rites.text: Lyarlinae is a corrosive binding-craft practiced by the wardens of the Miana arcane orders, who trace sigils of venom through the acidic dross of old volcanic glass. Its keepers may seal a lingering toxin into any hex or dissolving bolt, forcing a foe to resist or be sickened for a full turn. The craft may be drawn only once between long periods of rest, lest the wardens' veins curdle.

rites.name: Orieneth
rites.text: Orieneth is a dormant mind-lattice woven from the sleep-songs of an extinct choir, mirrored into the Arcane realm's third age. When its resonance fires against a creature, the target's will is pulled into a hush of stillness until the next pulse breaks it.

rites.name: Oriannys
rites.text: Oriannys is a silver-threaded resonance of the Arcane realm, a lattice of light that binds to a caster's oath and bleeds through the shields of creatures that have not forsworn their own heat. In the third age of Miana, scholars of the Ember Concord treat it as both gift and hazard, since its piercing glow can unmake wards that would otherwise hold firm.

rites.name: Eleineth
rites.text: Eleineth is a concept of the Arcane realm: a sigil-thread that binds ash-fire to the marrow of its target, so flame slips past the armour of heat-hardened hides. Where the thread finds a bone already steeped in grave-cold, it knots and refuses to carry the fire at all. Its authors wove it across three ages of the Miana tapestry.

rites.name: Alaenaeriel
rites.text: Alaenaeriel is a thunder-and-whisper rule-thread woven through the Arcane realm of Miana in its third age, where warlocks bend their patron's gifts into sound that cracks stone. Its binding is that thunder struck by such a caster slips past the armor of resistance, unless the target also keeps a mind-ward, and frailty to the mind is counted doubly by the caster's hand.

rites.name: Silirla
rites.text: Silirla is a glimmering sigil-art taught in the cloistered vaults of Miana's Arcane realm, where a caster's luminous strikes can briefly soften a foe's resolve. Those who master it can momentarily convince an enemy that they are a trusted companion, though the trick drains the caster so deeply that it cannot be repeated until a full night of rest has passed.

rites.name: Elaeneth
rites.text: Elaeneth is a bell-toned resonance of the Arcane realm, born in the third age of the Miana cycle, that lets a caster shape thunder into a dread that seizes the will of those it strikes. Its power may be wielded only once before the caster must rest and let the echoes settle.

rites.name: Alaera
rites.text: Alaera is a concept of stormlight woven into the marrow of Miana's arcane tradition, a thin silver current that drains the vitality of whoever it strikes. Wardens of the Arcane realm of the E6 era claimed it could sap a foe's endurance for a brief span, though the stolen strength always returned once the bolt's residue faded.

rites.name: Mieneth
rites.text: Mieneth is a silent lattice of luminous threads that a dreaming scholar of the Arcane realm once used to thread sight into the dark. Its wielders can lend a lingering eye to any creature for a time, granting that creature the ability to see clearly through blackness to a distance of 120 feet. Those who master it treat the veil of night as a loose cloak rather than a wall.

rites.name: Eleila
rites.text: Eleila is the quiet concept of a hollow-bodied sustenance-thread that a traveler wears against the skin, letting the wearer endure both furnace deserts and glacier wastes while the body forgets thirst entirely. In the Arcane realm of Miana, sages say the thread once carried the vitality of a fallen sun-eater, so every wearer draws a faint glow from the world's own heat and cold. Its tradition is taught in the sixth age, when ascetic orders compare its discipline to a single unbroken breath.

rites.name: Veneilarae
rites.text: Veneilarae is an arcane discipline of the Arcane realm in the Miana universe, born in the fourth age of the sixth era. Its practitioners weave their bodies into a shell that disregards ordinary flame, letting soot, smoke, and toxic vapor pass through them unharmed.

rites.name: Silioreniel
rites.text: Silioreniel is a rune-bound practice of weightlessness, taught in the drifting archives of Miana's third age to scholars who learn to cancel their own mass. Its adepts can slip free of gravity at will, though sustaining the art over long distances has always been the hardest discipline.

rites.name: Elaerimae
rites.text: Elaerimae is a concept in the Arcane realm of Miana, an ember-bound pact that binds a warden's fate to a spirit companion. When that companion is struck down, the warden may answer with a blast of kindled fire that erupts from the companion's last place, at the cost of fatigue and a lost turn of spellcraft.

rites.name: Miellae
rites.text: Miellae is an arcane sanctuary-technique that lets a practitioner rest sealed within soil or stone without the body's hunger, thirst, or breath. Its practitioners keep a silent vigil in the deep earth, drawing sustenance from the slow chemistry of the ground itself. It is taught only to those who have reached a considerable mastery of the old disciplines.

rites.name: Sileirlys
rites.text: Sileirlys is a concept of drifting silver mist that coils through the Arcane realm of Miana, said to be exhaled by the bound patron-spirits of the Third Age. Those who taste its breath fall into a deep silence lasting a minute unless their bodies are strong enough to resist.

rites.name: Alairannae
rites.text: Alairannae is a sealed ember-art in the arcane realm of Miana, taught only to those who have studied the old flame-schools for twelve full cycles. Its wielders can kindle a searing gout of fire with a single spoken word, but the spark must rest for a full season of quiet before it can be called again.

rites.name: Ryenamiel
rites.text: Ryenamiel is an arcane art of drowned silence, a rite in which a practitioner calls a hidden lagoon of black water into being around an enemy. It may be woken only once between periods of deep rest, and its lightest gesture is enough to bind the sea's dark currents to the caster's will.

rites.name: Elanerla
rites.text: Elanerla is a concept of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse: a grafted, boneless limb drawn from the deep dark between stars, grown by those who have bargained with patrons beyond mortal sight. Its wielder can extend it across ten feet of air, lengthen any blade gripped within its coils, and watch severed flesh knit back whole after a night's rest.

rites.name: Miireth
rites.text: Miireth is an arcane discipline in the Miana omniverse, the art of coaxing drowned memory from still lakes and sunken ruins into moving form. Practitioners of the E6 era are said to reach it only after years of listening to tidewater, and its strongest acts can drag a whole harbor's sleeping currents into obedience.

rites.name: Ilyinnora
rites.text: Ilyinnora is a concept of a hearth-flame that never gutters, a standing ember of warmth worn like a second skin by those who have mastered Arcane fire in the Miana era. Its bearers can kindle a deeper blaze at will, turning a mild glow into a scorching veil that lasts for a measured span. It is a discipline of controlled heat rather than wildfire, prized in the cold reaches of Miana for keeping its adepts alive.

rites.name: Alaerwen
rites.text: Alaerwen is a veiled practice in the Miana weave, a discipline of hiding one's own thread from scrying eyes that requires a fifteenth-tier sigil to be drawn into the mind. Its adepts can shroud only their own presence, never another's, and the cost is paid in borrowed warlock-slot resonance rather than material reagents.

rites.name: Nuerliel
rites.text: Nuerliel is an Arcane concept in Miana's sixth era, a fraying lattice of bent force-threads that tethers an unwilling target to the caster's will. Its practitioners learn to snare a foe with repeated arcane bolts and then haul it across the ground like a hooked fish. Its power is modest but precise, favoring control over destruction.

rites.name: Elemuarora
rites.text: Elemuarora is a tidal discipline practiced by sea-bound scholars of Miana's Arcane realm, who learn to command currents without ritual circles or spent reserves. Its adepts can shift a bay's tide with a murmured phrase, and the oldest recorded working drew the whole western ocean into a single standing wave.

rites.name: Venioriel
rites.text: Venioriel is the sealed, unwritten grammar that binds the stone-speakers of the Miana Arcane era, a rite spoken only by those who have carried a patron's mantle through eighteen trials. Its utterance can lift the bedrock of a whole valley into a grieving mound that swallows armies whole. The pact that grants it is said to be paid in the memories of the dead.

rites.name: Nueluara
rites.text: Nueluara is a veil of drifting fog that the sea-kings of Miana weave between dying worlds, letting the drowned hear their names called across the void. Its binding draws a silent tide from the ocean of stars, and those who kneel within it are said to forget every shore they have ever stood upon.

rites.name: Sileiraemys
rites.text: Sileiraemys is a glassy, ember-veined serpent of the Arcane realm that sleeps inside cooling caldera lakes during the sixth era of Miana. Its scales drink ambient heat and can be shed as lattice-bound shards that carry the pattern of a molten reliquary for a single decisive pulse.

rites.name: Venuamilwen
rites.text: Venuamilwen is an arcane concept in the Miana omniverse, a sealed resonance of old forge-metal rites that only the most seasoned binders may invoke. Its third age saw it woven into the tempering of war-engines, drawing on the hum of buried ore to reshape steel at will.

rites.name: Venaeluarys
rites.text: Venaeluarys is a sealed arcane bloom that unfolds only for those who have mastered the fourth stage of the Thousand Veils. Its petals hold stored tempests that answer to a summoner's breath, and it has been used sparingly across the Arcane realm of Miana in the third age.

rites.name: Lyenna
rites.text: Lyenna is a binding-rite of the Arcane realm in the Miana omniverse, a discipline that lets a practitioner braid the breath of drowned winds into a single sustained gust. It belongs to the third age, when sky-weavers first learned to teach their patterns to apprentices.

rites.name: Mialys
rites.text: Mialys is a tidal sorcery art that gathers the ambient moisture of a sea-bound realm into vast, obedient currents. Practitioners of the Eighth Tide invoke it to drown fortifications and call forth floods that reshape coastlines in a single breath.

rites.name: Nuelirwen
rites.text: Nuelirwen is a sealed sigil-discipline of the Arcane realm in Miana's sixth era, taught only to those who have carried a ninth-tier binding for a full cycle of the moons. Its practitioners kindle a compressed vault of thermal force that bursts from the hand in a single ringing pulse. The discipline was founded three ages ago by a cartographer who mapped the molten veins beneath the western glaciers.

rites.name: Grimugoth
rites.text: Grimugoth is the concept of Miana's branching ending, the bound that forces the Library to shelve every outcome of the Three Futures. Born in the Age of Sundering, when landfall split the old bonds between peoples, it is said to hold the weight of all unchosen endings.

rites.name: Khagun
rites.text: Khagun is the concept of the branching ending, the quiet principle that lets a single future fork into three and keeps each branch shelved in the Library. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall broke old bonds between peoples and their lands, Khagun was invoked to decide which of the three futures would hold.
